title: Full Stack Product Engineer (100% Remote - Germany | UK | Ireland)
description:
Build analytics people can trust. Help define what analytics looks like in an AI-first world. 

Most analytics platforms ask organisations to trade control for insight.

For almost 20 years, Matomo has shown there is another way: powerful, transparent and trustworthy analytics that respects privacy, gives organisations ownership of their data, and helps people understand what's happening, make better decisions, and improve their work.

More than one million websites use Matomo. That means you'll work on software that is widely used, technically demanding, and close enough to customers that your work has a visible impact. It's a rare opportunity for engineers: solving meaningful, complex product problems while seeing the difference your work makes for customers.

We are independent, profitable, and open source. We are not trying to become a smaller copy of Big Tech analytics platforms. We are building a different kind of analytics company: one where privacy, transparency, customer control, and product quality are part of the core product, not marketing claims.

This role focuses on Matomo Core, the foundation of our product and the platform our open-source users, cloud customers, and wider plugin ecosystem depend on.

If you want unusually high ownership, visible impact, hard product & platform problems, and the opportunity to strengthen a widely used open-source platform , Matomo is worth a serious look.

Why this role matters 

Matomo Core is the foundation of our open-source product, cloud platform, plugins, integrations and customer-facing features. 

It has evolved over many years and operates across a wide range of environments, use cases and data volumes. Every improvement to Core benefits customers, open-source users, plugin developers and engineering teams across the Matomo ecosystem. 

We are bringing responsibility for Core into a newly formed European team. You'll help shape how this team works, where it focuses and how it creates the greatest impact across Matomo. 

As a Product Engineer, you’ll help decide where Core can create the greatest impact. That could mean solving a difficult customer problem, strengthening an existing capability, creating a new platform capability, or simplifying the Core platform to make it easier to evolve. 

You’ll work on a mature and technically complex product. The challenge is not simply to preserve what exists. It is to understand why it exists, recognise where it is holding customers or engineers back, and evolve it without disrupting the open-source users, customers, integrations and plugins that already depend on it. 

What you’ll own 

You'll own problems, not just code. 

This is not a traditional feature-ticket engineering role. You'll understand customer problems, shape solutions, build across the stack, ship incrementally and continuously improve what you release. AI should be part of your everyday workflow. 

You'll own work from problem to outcome: 

- 
Understand the problem before committing to a solution. 

- 
Help shape priorities, not just implement them. 

- 
Build across the stack wherever the problem takes you. 

- 
Ship incrementally and learn from real usage. 

- 
Measure outcomes and iterate. 

- 
Use AI throughout your workflow. 

For senior: You'll help shape what we build, not only how we build it. You'll identify opportunities others haven't seen, influence technical and product direction, and help establish how the Core team operates as it grows. 

For intermediate: You'll contribute to deciding what we build, working closely with product, engineering and customers rather than simply implementing predefined requirements. You'll own meaningful problems end-to-end while building confidence in navigating ambiguity and product trade-offs. 

What the work looks like 

You'll work across the Core platform wherever you can create the greatest impact. 

Examples include: 

- 
Diagnosing and solving complex problems across a large, mature codebase. 

- 
Strengthening the security, performance, scalability, reliability and resilience of Matomo. 

- 
Protecting the integrity, accuracy and trustworthiness of the data customers rely on. 

- 
Strengthen capabilities that support increasingly demanding enterprise use cases. 

- 
Building and evolving APIs and platform capabilities used by Matomo plugins and integrations. 

- 
Evolving how Matomo handles consent, privacy and responsible data collection. 

- 
Advancing server-side tracking, data anonymisation and data-health monitoring. 

- 
Enhancing analytics capabilities such as goals, ecommerce reporting and dashboards.

- 
Simplifying complex analytics workflows and making powerful functionality easier to use. 

- 
Evolving Matomo's design system to create a more consistent and usable product experience. 

How we work 

We’re a small team competing with companies many times our size.

That means we optimise for impact.

We value:

- 
Customer problems over technical elegance.

- 
Shipping over endless planning.

- 
Simple solutions over unnecessary complexity.

- 
Ownership over handoffs.

- 
Iteration over perfection.

- 
Clear writing over excessive meetings.

- 
Pragmatic engineering over abstract architecture.

- 
AI where it helps us move faster.

- 
Measuring outcomes over assuming we were right.

We care about high standards, but we do not confuse high standards with slow processes. We would rather ship a small useful improvement, learn from it, and improve it than spend months perfecting something before customers see it.

At the same time, changes to Matomo Core can affect a large number of customers, integrations and plugins. You should be able to move pragmatically while recognising when additional investigation, testing or migration planning is necessary.

What we’re looking for 

For senior: You're already operating with a high degree of autonomy. You naturally identify valuable opportunities, make pragmatic decisions in ambiguous situations, and multiply the team's impact through the systems you build, the decisions you influence and the way you approach problems. 

For intermediate: You're already comfortable delivering software independently and are looking to take greater ownership of customer problems, product decisions and technical direction. 

You enjoy building products 

You get motivated by solving customer problems and delivering value, not by technical novelty alone.

You care whether people actually use and benefit from what you build. Seeing a feature make a real difference is more rewarding to you than building something technically clever that nobody uses.

You naturally ask:

- 
What problem are we solving?

- 
Who has this problem?

- 
Is this the simplest useful solution?

- 
How will we know this made things better?

- 
What should we do if the data shows we were wrong?

You are comfortable with complex, mature systems 

You do not need every problem to start with a clean architecture or an empty repository.

You are comfortable tracing behaviour across an unfamiliar codebase, understanding historical constraints, debugging difficult interactions, and making incremental improvements without unnecessary rewrites.

You can balance immediate customer needs with longer-term platform health. You know when to fix the immediate issue, when to address the underlying cause, and when a broader architectural change is justified.

You are comfortable across the stack

You are happy working wherever the problem takes you: frontend, backend, databases, APIs, product flows, documentation, or customer feedback.

Our stack includes PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, Vue.js, and TypeScript. Exact stack experience is useful, but not required. We care more about your ability to learn, reason, ship, and solve meaningful problems.

You use AI as part of how you work

We make heavy use of AI-assisted development throughout our engineering workflow.

You should already be using AI tools regularly or be strongly motivated to do so. We expect Product Engineers to use AI to increase output and quality.

AI does not replace your judgment. You remain responsible for product decisions, technical correctness, security, privacy, maintainability, and customer impact.

You’ll probably thrive here if 

- 
You prefer owning outcomes over receiving detailed tickets.

- 
You enjoy solving difficult problems in existing systems as well as building new functionality.

- 
You can quickly diagnose complex or intermittent bugs.

- 
You can move from customer feedback or operational evidence to investigation, product decision and implementation.

- 
You care about reliability, performance and data accuracy, not only visible feature work.

- 
You can improve a mature codebase without assuming it needs to be rewritten.

- 
You use AI tools heavily and are actively improving how you work with them.

- 
You are pragmatic: you can make a focused improvement now while recognising when a deeper change is needed.

- 
You can explain technical and product trade-offs clearly.

- 
You enjoy working across product, engineering, UX, data and customer feedback.

- 
You like small teams where your decisions and output visibly matter.

below for intermediate only:

- 
You're excited to take on increasingly ambiguous problems. 

- 
You want to grow beyond implementation into shaping products and technical decisions. 

You may not enjoy this role if 

- 
You mainly want to work on new greenfield products.

- 
You see maintenance, debugging, reliability or performance work as less valuable than feature development.

- 
You want a product manager to define most requirements before you start.

- 
You are uncomfortable investigating problems where the cause is initially unclear.

- 
You prefer replacing existing systems rather than understanding why they work as they do.

- 
You measure success mainly by code quality rather than user or business impact.

- 
You are uncomfortable using AI as part of your normal engineering workflow.

- 
You need a large team, narrow responsibilities, or highly formal processes to be effective.

- 
You prefer polishing a solution extensively before showing it to users.

- 
You dislike writing proposals, documentation, or product notes.

- 
You are uncomfortable balancing speed, backwards compatibility and long-term platform health.

Remote work 

Matomo is a remote company.

We work mostly asynchronously and rely heavily on clear written communication. You should be comfortable working independently, documenting your thinking, and collaborating without needing constant meetings.

Location 
100% remote — Germany, UK or Ireland only.

Hiring process 

Our process is designed to understand how you think, build, communicate, and use AI in realistic product engineering work.

The process usually includes: Application → Screening → Online aptitude test → People & Culture interview → Technical skills interview → Final technical interview.

We do not expect unpaid multi-day projects. We want to understand how you approach ambiguous problems, make trade-offs, use AI, and ship useful product improvements.

Diversity and Inclusion 
InnoCraft (trading as Matomo) values what makes you unique. We’re an inclusive employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, because diverse perspectives help us build better products.

Interested? 
If you care about solving meaningful customer problems, improving software that people depend on, working with high ownership, and making privacy-friendly analytics more secure, reliable, accurate and useful, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Working Student Global Licensing (DACH) (all genders)
description:
Über tonies: tonies ist die weltweit führende interaktive Audio-Plattform für Kinder mit mehr als 10 Millionen verkauften Tonieboxen und 125 Millionen Tonies. Das intuitive und preisgekrönte Audiosystem hat die Art und Weise, wie kleine Kinder unabhängig spielen und lernen, durch seinen kindersicheren, kabellosen und bildschirmfreien Ansatz verändert. Tonieboxen wurden bereits in über 100 Ländern aktiviert, und das Portfolio umfasst rund 1.400 Tonies in mehreren Sprachen. Seit der Gründung hat tonies bedeutende Meilensteine erreicht, darunter die Börsennotierung an der Frankfurter Wertpapierbörse im November 2021 sowie ein global aufgestelltes Team von über 550 engagierten Experten, die aus verschiedenen Ländern agieren. 

Teil unseres tonies-Teams zu werden bedeutet, an einer inspirierenden Mission mitzuwirken: innovative und bedeutungsvolle Erlebnisse für Kinder auf der ganzen Welt zu schaffen. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft des Spielens, Lernens und der Fantasie. 

Du als Teil von tonies: Bei Tonies Licensing haben wir es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, die Magie von Audio zu Kindern überall auf der Welt zu bringen. Wir suchen eine motivierte und begeisterte Studentische Nachwuchskraft (m/w/d), die unser Portfolio an globalen Lizenzkonten unterstützt und dabei hilft, internationale Lizenzprojekte von der ersten Idee bis zum finalen Produktlaunch voranzutreiben. Diese Rolle ist perfekt für jemanden, der wertvolle Praxiserfahrung in einem kommerziell ausgerichteten Umfeld sammeln möchte – an der Seite eines Teams, das Beziehungen zu großen internationalen Lizenzgebern der Spielzeug- und Unterhaltungsbranche in Nordamerika und der EMEA-Region betreut. 

Deine Aufgaben umfassen: - Unterstützung im Lizenzmanagement: Du unterstützt das Lizenz-Team bei der Pflege und Koordination der Beziehungen zu internationalen Lizenzpartnern.
- Mitarbeit an internationalen Projekten: Du begleitest internationale Lizenzprojekte über verschiedene Phasen hinweg – von den ersten Gesprächen über den Vertragsabschluss bis hin zur Produktentwicklung und dem Marktstart.
- Kaufmännische Unterstützung: Du hilfst bei der Erstellung und Pflege von Lizenz-GuVs (Gewinn- und Verlustrechnungen) und unterstützt bei der Ausarbeitung von Berichten sowie Präsentationen für interne Stakeholder.
- Schnittstellenkoordination: Du unterstützt die Kommunikation zwischen internen Fachbereichen (z. B. Produktentwicklung, Marketing, Recht, Finanzen) und externen Lizenzagenturen oder -partnern.
- Markt- & Branchenrecherche: Du recherchierst aktuelle Trends sowie Entwicklungen in der globalen Lizenz- und Unterhaltungsbranche und bereitest die Ergebnisse für das Team auf.

Was wir uns von dir wünschen: - Studium: Immatrikulierte/r Student/in, idealerweise in Betriebswirtschaftslehre (BWL), Medienmanagement, Kommunikationswissenschaften oder einem verwandten Studiengang.
- Brancheninteresse: Erste Berührungspunkte mit oder Interesse an der globalen Spielzeug- und Unterhaltungsindustrie.
- Zahlenaffinität: Grundlegendes Verständnis kaufmännischer Konzepte sowie ein sicherer Umgang mit Excel und Berichten.
- Vorerfahrung von Vorteil: Praktika oder Tätigkeiten als Werkstudent/in im Bereich Lizenzierung, Marketing oder Business Development sind von Vorteil, aber kein Muss.
- Kommunikationsstärke: Gute Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch sowie ein selbstsicheres Auftreten im Kontakt mit externen Partnern.
- Persönlichkeit: Proaktive, strukturierte und lernbegierige Persönlichkeit, die gerne eigenverantwortlich arbeitet und sich in einem internationalen, dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlt.

Warum tonies? - Globales Teamwork: Wir arbeiten über Abteilungs- und Ländergrenzen hinweg an unserer Vision, die Toniebox in jedes Kinderzimmer der Welt zu bringen.
- Come as you are: Das gilt nicht nur für den Dresscode, sondern für alles andere auch. Denn nur wo du dich wirklich wohlfühlst, kannst du dein Bestes geben.
- Sprachen lernen & Entspannung: Verbessere deine Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Sprachlern-App Babbel und finde Entspannung durch unseren Zugang zur Meditations-App Calm.

title: Engineering Manager - Experience Above the Box (all genders)
description:
About tonies: tonies is the globally leading interactive audio platform for children with more than 10 million Tonieboxes and 125 million Tonies sold. The intuitive and award-winning audio system has changed the way young children play and learn independently with its child-safe, wireless, and screen-free approach. Tonieboxes have been activated in over 100 countries, the content portfolio includes around 1,400 Tonies in several languages. Since its inception, tonies has achieved significant milestones, including listing on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in November 2021 as well as a globally present team of over 550 dedicated professionals operating from various countries.

Joining our tonies team means being part of an inspiring mission to create innovative and meaningful experiences for children around the world. Together, we’re shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.

You as part of tonies: Above the box is where the magic of tonies becomes tangible: the Tonies themselves — Content, Creative, Clever — and Tonieplay. As Engineering Manager (all genders) for our Above-the-Box value stream, you lead a cross-functional team that owns these experiences end to end — from the device through App and cloud, across every Toniebox generation and every device our products will run on next.

The team is newly formed and set to grow, with a mix of internal and external engineers. Together with your Product Manager, you shape both the experiences we ship and the team that builds them, bringing joy to millions of children worldwide. Ready to help us create the future of audio play?

Your tasks and responsibilities will include: - Team Leadership: You nurture the professional growth of your engineers and build a culture where inclusive mentorship, continuous learning, and high collaboration are the norm — across disciplines, and across internal and external team members alike. 
- Building & Scaling the Team: You grow the team as our roadmap grows: shaping the profiles we hire, onboarding and integrating external engineers, and making sure critical knowledge stays with the team rather than walking out the door. 
- End-to-End Ownership: You make your team genuinely accountable for its experiences — embedded, app, and cloud — rather than handing work over at team boundaries. 
- Architectural Oversight: You oversee the structural integrity of the Above-the-Box implementations, ensuring a consistent user experience across multiple device generations through clean abstractions and cross-functional end-to-end ownership. 
- Interfaces & Dependencies: You define the application-level APIs your team needs from our platform teams and turn cross-team dependencies into clear, testable contracts instead of coordination overhead. 
- Product Sync & Strategy: You synchronise with Product Management to prioritise features and technical debt, ensuring that every engineering cycle directly fuels the overarching tonies® product vision. 
- Leading Through Change: You bring the team through transitions with a clear vision, identifying what needs to improve and driving those improvements together with your engineers. 
- Technical Credibility & Hands-on Depth: You stay close enough to the code to run high-impact reviews, challenge architectural decisions, and step in on critical problems — so our quality standards remain uncompromised, including for work delivered by external partners. 
- Delivery Excellence: You manage the end-to-end delivery process, applying lean principles to streamline workflows and ensure stable, plannable, reliable releases for our customers. 
Your Team's Responsibilities - Designing, building, and maintaining the Above-the-Box experience — our value stream covering everything our users experience beyond the box itself: 

- Content-, Creative- and Clever Tonies 

- Tonieplay 

- Delivering these experiences across the full stack, from on-device software through app and cloud services 

- Specifying the abstract interfaces (APIs) delivered by our lower-level platform teams, so the team can own its experiences end to end across hardware generations 

- Safeguarding quality through end-to-end ownership and test automation owned inside the team 

- Partnering closely with Product Management to translate the experience roadmap into sustainable delivery 

- Acting as the point of contact for Above-the-Box topics across the wider engineering organisation 

What we are looking for: - Leadership & Team Empowerment: You have experience leading engineering teams—including specialists outside your own discipline—and excel at turning complex challenges into a clear vision. You seamlessly integrate external engineers and partners to build one unified team grounded in shared standards, collective ownership, and zero second-class contributors. 

- Technical Acumen & Hands-on Depth: You bring a long-standing background as a software engineer with genuine full-stack breadth — you have depth in embedded, backend, or mobile development , and enough working knowledge of the others to reason about, review, and challenge decisions across the whole stack. While your focus is on leadership and design, you can still dive into the codebase to unblock critical bottlenecks. 

- Architectural Vision: You advocate for modular, flexibly extendable, loosely coupled architectures with strong cohesion — so a feature can be built once and shipped across several hardware generations without being rewritten each time. 

- Strategic Product Alignment: You act as the bridge between engineering and product strategy. You translate business goals into technical reality and collaborate seamlessly across departments to keep our roadmap both ambitious and achievable. 

- The Toolbox: Solid experience with software platforms and their architecture. Linux is your home ground, and Git, GitLab, and CI/CD are part of your daily workflow. Experience working with ODMs or hardware suppliers is a strong plus. 

- Clean Design & Simplicity: You champion lean structures and have a knack for solving complex problems with simple, elegant solutions — in code and in organisational processes alike. 

- Work Style: Your approach is defined by agility, empathy, and creativity, especially when exploring new solutions or navigating change. 

- Communication & Collaboration: You communicate confidently in professional English (German is a plus) and enjoy being with your team in the office regularly. 

- Last but not least: You are enthusiastic about our product and want to join us on our exciting journey! 

Why tonies? - Global Teamwork: We collaborate across departmental and country borders on our vision to bring the Toniebox into every child's room in the world.

- Come as you are: This applies not only to the dress code but also to everything else. Because only where you truly feel comfortable can you give your best.

- Mobility : Choose the option that suits you best – a Deutschlandticket (public transport ticket) for unlimited mobility, a monthly contribution for an office parking space, a leasing bicycle, or a remote work subsidy.

- Enhanced Security: Benefit from subsidies for company pension plans, occupational pension schemes, and occupational disability insurance.

- Rest & Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of paid annual leave plus three additional days off such as Rosenmontag, Christmas Eve, and New Year's Eve. After one year of employment, you can also use up to 10 "toniecation days" (unpaid leave days).

- Continuous Learning : Benefit from our internal and external training opportunities as well as an individual learning budget to continuously expand your knowledge.

- Language Learning & Relaxation: Improve your communication skills with the language learning app Babbel and find relaxation through our access to the meditation app Calm.

- Discounts: Benefit from attractive discounts on our entire range of tonies products.

Good to know: As part of our principles, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity at tonies. We actively celebrate our colleagues’ different abilities, ethnicities, faith and gender. Everyone is welcome and supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**Verdancy is a start up in the making from the Schwaneberg Group at the Institute of Biotechnology of RWTH Aachen University. It develops biodegradable additives that make crop-protection products stick to leaves and last longer. Bio-based microgels carry the active substance and release it on demand, while bi-adhesive peptides anchor the microgel to the leaf wax so the coating survives rain — meaning fewer sprays and less pesticide lost to the environment. A second product line uses bifunctional peptides (antimicrobial peptide + anchor) as peptide-based pesticides in their own right, protected by patent EP3261435B1. Verdancy already has a developed business model, funding secured through May 2027 via the Warp Speed Fund of the Materials Lab Incubator (MerLIn), a successful soybean-rust project and a new €2.4m insect-focused project starting January 2027. What's missing is the business development leadership to found the spin-off company and go after an €80B addressable market (€1.2B in the copper segment alone).

eit über 50 Jahren betreut Kohnle & Partner anspruchsvolle Mandate in allen wirtschaftlichen und steuerlichen Fragen. Mit inzwischen knapp 100 Mitarbeitenden an vier Standorten gehören wir zu den führenden Kanzleien in der Region Baden.

Digitalisierung ist für uns kein Schlagwort, sondern gelebte Realität. Mit innovativen Tools, automatisierten Workflows und eigenen Inhouse‑IT‑Lösungen gehen wir weit über klassische Steuerberatung hinaus. Wir verbinden Effizienz, Sicherheit und moderne Technologie – für unsere Mandanten und unser Team. Und genau hier kommst DU ins Spiel.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben – Leidenschaftlicher Problemlöser. Digitaler Möglichmacher. Zukunftsdenker. 

Bei uns arbeitest du nicht mit Papier, sondern mit intelligenten, digitalen Systemen. Du gestaltest unsere IT‑Landschaft aktiv mit und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kanzlei technologisch immer einen Schritt voraus ist. In deinem zukünftigen Aufgabenbereich erwarten dich unter anderem:

- Betreuung, Weiterentwicklung und Administration unserer IT‑Systeme und Infrastruktur

- Support und Beratung unserer Mitarbeitenden bei technischen Fragen

- Einsatz von KI‑Tools zur Optimierung von IT- und Supportprozessen

- Einrichtung und Pflege von Hard- und Software

- Schnittstellen intern und zur Mandantenanbindung, insbesondere im DATEV‑Umfeld

- Technische Betreuung der Mandantenanbindung, inklusive Onboarding und Datenaustausch

- Mitwirkung bei der Einführung neuer digitaler Tools und Automatisierungen

- IT‑Sicherheit, Datenschutz und Systemstabilität

- Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen (2nd‑Level‑Support)

- Zusammenarbeit mit Dienstleistern, Mandanten und Fachbereichen

- Mitarbeit bei IT‑Projekten, von Prozessoptimierung bis Systemmigration

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit. 

Wir sind stolz darauf, zu den führenden Kanzleien im Raum Baden zu zählen. Ein Grund hierfür ist sicherlich unsere Unternehmensphilosophie der stetigen Weiterentwicklung – auch unsere Mitarbeiter bilden da keine Ausnahme. Wir legen großen Wert auf kontinuierliche persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung. Auf diesem Weg unterstützen wir jeden Mitarbeiter individuell, jedoch setzen wir auch ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative voraus.

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT‑Bereich (z. B. Fachinformatiker Systemintegration, Systeminformatiker) oder ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Windows‑Systemen, Netzwerken, Serverlandschaften und IT‑Security

- Erfahrung mit Microsoft‑Umgebungen, insbesondere MS 365

- Idealerweise Kenntnisse in DATEV‑Systemen – kein Muss, aber ein Plus

- Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise

- Teamfähigkeit, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Lust auf Weiterentwicklung

Benefits

Warum Kohnle? 

Eine gute Frage – die wir auch unserem Team gestellt haben. Die Antworten sprechen für sich: Besonders geschätzt werden bei uns die echten Karrieremöglichkeiten, die gelebte Wertschätzung und unser innovativer, digitaler Ansatz. Und das Beste: Fast alle würden uns als Arbeitgeber an Freunde und Familie weiterempfehlen. Ein schöner Beweis dafür, dass wir einiges richtig machen.

Natürlich bekommst Du bei uns nicht nur spannende Aufgaben, sondern auch viele Vorteile, die Deinen Arbeitsalltag angenehmer machen:

- Regelmäßige Events – ob Sommerfest, Betriebsausflug oder Weihnachtsfeier – wir feiern Erfolge gemeinsam

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten – für eine bessere Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben

- Förderung von Fortbildungen – Deine Entwicklung ist uns wichtig – fachlich und persönlich

- Hochwertiges Inhouse Fitnessstudio am Standort Weingarten

- Modernste Technik & digitale Prozesse – papierlos, effizient und zukunftssicher

- Gesundheitsbenefits – von ergonomischer Ausstattung bis Gesundheitsaktionen

- Hochwertige Büros & Einrichtung – damit Du Dich auch optisch wohlfühlst

- Eigene Parkplätze am Standort Weingarten

- Klimatisierte Räume – für einen kühlen Kopf, auch an heißen Tagen

- Social Areas drinnen & draußen – für den Austausch, die Pause oder einfach einen guten Kaffee

Ein kleiner Schritt für dich. 

Ein großer für deine Karriere. 

Überzeugt? Dann melde dich bei uns - wir freuen uns auf dich!

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Ad Performance Recommendation
description:
We are seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to join our 200+ product development organization and lead our Ad Performance Recommendation team . The team is responsible for developing an innovative AI-powered system that leverages marketing ad tech data and various data sources to identify performance signals and generate actionable recommendations for digital advertisers and marketers. 

As part of the AI Platform organization, you will lead a multidisciplinary team of Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and Software Engineers working to accelerate AI adoption and development across Smartly's Media, Creative, and Intelligence suite. The team ensures compliance with privacy, security, and ethical guidelines.

This is an opportunity to define the vision and strategy for ML and Data Science applications, drive execution on ambitious goals, and champion AI and ML excellence throughout Smartly.

Smartly is proud to be ranked as a leader in The Forrester Wave™ for Creative AdTech. This recognition reflects our commitment to transforming ad experiences through intelligent creativity, standing as the only platform honored by both Forrester and validated by PwC to be recognized for ad technology to power performance.

To get an idea of some of the work we do, see for example these blog posts:

How We Productized Bayesian Revenue Estimation with Stan 

Optimizing Conversions with Predictive Budget Allocation 

Here's What You'll Do: 

- Lead and grow the Ad Performance Recommendation team, providing technical direction, strategic vision, and hands-on leadership.

- Drive the development of AdTech-specific ML models foundational AI capabilities (e.g. predictive and simulation techniques) and explore novel approaches that can be applied across Smartly's products. Optimize existing models for performance, efficiency, and scalability.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with other teams to ensure AI-driven features deliver measurable business and customer impact.

- Ensure compliance with privacy, security, and ethical AI standards in ML applications.

- Foster a strong engineering culture focused on innovation, quality, and continuous improvement.

- Mentor team members through coaching, 1:1s, and career development plans.

- Remove obstacles to enable your team to thrive and deliver exceptional results.

- Partner with recruiting to help scale the team by actively sourcing and closing the best talent. 

- Partner with other leaders in the AI Platform to shape Smartly's long-term AI strategy and architecture.

Here's What We're Looking For… 

- 7+ years of experience in building services and products.

- 5+ years of experience in applying machine learning to real-life problems.

- 3+ years of experience in leading teams.

- Competent with key technologies in ML; PyTorch, TensorFlow, Python, SQL. 

- Able to mentor, coach, and develop data scientists and machine learning engineers

- Proven experience in delivering scalable ML systems in production. You will need to be hands-on when coaching the team members to new technical and professional heights, which can involve code reviews, pair programming, etc.

- A pragmatic mindset. We always aim to create value to our customers. We're also working on production systems and our customers' business depends on it.

- Curiosity and the drive to continuously learn through study and experimentation on the job. 

- Ability to drive both technical excellence and cross-functional collaboration.

- Understanding of security and compliance requirements when working with personal data.

- M.Sc. or Ph.D. in a relevant field (Mathematics, CS, AI, Physics, …).

- Excellent communication skills, written and spoken English

- Ability to work 3 days / week at our office

What we offer you… 

- Ownership Culture: Make a significant impact on our products with autonomy and ownership.

- Industry Collaboration: Collaborate with leading online marketers and platforms like Meta, Pinterest, Snap, TikTok, and Google.

- Professional Development: Access opportunities for growth through mentorship, training, and resources to enhance your skills.

- Wellbeing Focus: Prioritize your health with comprehensive healthcare packages and mental health services, plus a healthy work-life balance.

- Total Rewards: Everyone at Smartly is an owner with our equity options program and performance-based grants. We recognize success with compensation, benefits, and career development opportunities. 

- We work in a flexible hybrid work model, including the option to work abroad for up to 30 days.

Smartly is committed to being the best place to work for growth-minded individuals to thrive - explore more in our Culture Handbook !

What to Expect from Our Recruitment Experience: 

- Meet your Recruiter: Get to know each other and learn about working at Smartly.

- Meet the Team Manager: Gain deeper insights into your future team.

- Meet the Team in Subject Matter Interviews: Engage in a case study and showcase your domain knowledge.

- Meet the Leadership in a Final Meeting: A brief discussion with our Chief Technical Officer.

Apply now and shape the future of digital advertising!

Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer (Multiple Domains)
description:
About Wolt 

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

Analytics at Wolt is a business-critical area that covers three different teams: data science, regional business operations, and analytics engineering. The complexity of online delivery, differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, and vast amounts of data make our work truly interesting!

Now we are looking for three experienced Senior Analytics Engineers to join our Analytics Engineering teams. We have three domains available: Consumer, Merchant, or Ads . You can work in Berlin, Stockholm or Helsinki .

About the role 

The role is focused on the business needs - you'll be working within a cross-functional team, making sure your teammates get the insights needed for their operations. The role requires interpreting the needs and requests of our internal stakeholders from business and product, and transforming them into actionable data. Data Scientists working in the domain will be your closest partners in your day-to-day work, as your solutions will enable them to create relevant experiments, A/B tests, and analyses.

Your daily work will include 

- Developing reporting and metrics quality as a whole, from understanding the needs of the business to providing easily understandable and actionable data. 

- Working on our centrally maintained data integrations and data pipelines powering our Data Warehouse, our data models, and dashboards. You'll get to utilize our modern tech stack as part of your work (Snowflake, SQL, Looker, Wolt Inhouse ETL, Airflow, Dagster, Github).

- Design and implement complex data pipelines with dependency control, orchestration, and auto-materialisation logic.

- Develop a self-service data modelling strategy and partner with Analytics and other stakeholders for implementation.

- Increase data literacy across the domain and expertise through hands-on training and documentation.

- Lead, mentor, and guide more junior team members.

Our humble expectations 

- 5+ years of experience working as an Analytics Engineer or BI Developer.

- Strong hands-on experience with data integrations, data pipelines, data models, metric development, and dashboards .

- Tech skills: Snowflake, SQL, Airflow, DBT, Looker, or other visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, etc.

- Advanced SQL skills and ability to write optimized queries for large data sets.

- Strong business acumen and product-oriented thinking with significant experience in the design and implementation of analytics and reporting data models.

What we offer

- The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics.

- You can choose the location from our tech hubs in Berlin, Stockholm or Helsinki . You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote within the location above. 💙 

- You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don't learn, we won't stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda's greatest achievement.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Product+ Talent Acquisition Partner - Zhanna Filintseva via 

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. 

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Marketing Manager (m/w/d)  Brand, Content & E-Commerce · Vollzeit · Münster
description:
Zwei Marken. Viele Ideen. Und du bringst sie in die Umsetzung. 

leevje und I AM EDITIONS stehen für Mode, Ästhetik und eine starke Community. Während leevje seit vielen Jahren für besondere Kinderkollektionen steht, entwickeln wir mit I AM EDITIONS unsere Womenswear-Marke mit einem klaren, modernen und hochwertigen Look konsequent weiter.

Für unser Team in Münster suchen wir ein echtes Organisationstalent mit Gespür für Fashion, Content und digitales Marketing .

Du behältst den Überblick, übernimmst Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen, Kollektionen und Strategien konkrete Kampagnen, Inhalte und Launches entstehen.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

- Du planst und pflegst unseren Marketing-, Content- und Launchkalender.

- Du koordinierst Kampagnen und sorgst dafür, dass Inhalte und Assets rechtzeitig fertig sind.

- Du planst und betreust unsere Instagram-Kanäle und setzt Postings und Stories um.

- Du produzierst bei Bedarf selbst einfachen Foto- und Video-Content und fühlst dich auch vor der Kamera wohl – spontan in einer Story zu sprechen oder selbst Teil unseres Contents zu sein, ist für dich kein Problem.

- Du organisierst Shootings und koordinierst interne sowie externe Content-Ressourcen und UGC-Creator.

- Du planst und erstellst unsere Newsletter in Klaviyo und entwickelst Kampagnen, Segmente und automatisierte Flows weiter.

- Du planst und setzt unsere WhatsApp-Kommunikation um.

- Du pflegst Produkte und Inhalte in Shopify , legst neue Produkte an und erstellst Produkt-, Launch- und Shoptexte.

- Du aktualisierst Collections, Landingpages und Shopinhalte rund um unsere Drops.

- Du sorgst dafür, dass Kampagnen nicht nur geplant, sondern auch sauber und pünktlich umgesetzt werden.

- Je nach Erfahrung und Interesse kannst du weitere Bereiche wie Paid-Social-Creatives und Performance Marketing mit übernehmen.

Qualifikation

Das solltest du mitbringen

- Du bist sehr gut organisiert und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Themen den Überblick.

- Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und eigenständig.

- Du übernimmst Verantwortung und denkst selbstständig die nächsten Schritte mit.

- Du hast ein gutes ästhetisches Gespür für Mode, Bildsprache und Marken.

- Du bist kommunikativ, offen und präsent und hast keine Scheu davor, selbst vor der Kamera zu stehen und unsere Marken authentisch nach außen zu vertreten.

- Du interessierst dich für Social Media, Content, E-Commerce und CRM.

- Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung im Marketing, E-Commerce, Fashion-, Beauty- oder Lifestyle-Umfeld mit.

- Erfahrung mit Shopify und Klaviyo ist ein Plus – wichtiger ist uns, dass du dich schnell und eigenständig in neue Tools einarbeitest.

- Du hast ein gutes Sprachgefühl und kannst Texte sicher formulieren.

- Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gutes Englisch.

Berufserfahrung ist für uns ein Plus – aber nicht entscheidend. 

Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du organisiert bist, mitdenkst, Verantwortung übernimmst und ein echtes Gespür für unsere Marken mitbringst.

Wer besonders gut zu uns passt

Du bist jemand, der bei einem bevorstehenden Drop automatisch denkt:

Was brauchen wir dafür? Wer produziert was? Wann müssen die Bilder fertig sein? Sind die Produkte online? Ist Instagram vorbereitet? Stehen Newsletter und WhatsApp? Und ist am Launch-Tag wirklich alles ready? 

Du magst schöne Dinge – aber genauso sehr magst du es, wenn ein Plan aufgeht.

Genau diese Verbindung aus Organisation, Ästhetik, Kommunikation und Hands-on-Mentalität suchen wir.

Rahmenbedingungen

- Vollzeit / 40 Stunden pro Woche

- Arbeitsort: Münster

- Präsenzstelle bei uns im Team vor Ort

- Start: idealerweise zwischen dem 01.12.2026 und 01.01.2027

Über uns

leevje und I AM EDITIONS sind inhabergeführte Fashionbrands aus Münster.

Wir arbeiten mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, entwickeln unsere Marken konsequent weiter und möchten besonders I AM EDITIONS in den kommenden Jahren stark ausbauen.

Wir suchen niemanden, der nur Aufgaben abarbeitet, sondern jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt, Struktur schafft, mitdenkt und gemeinsam mit uns unsere Marken weiterentwickelt. 

Klingt nach dir? 

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

title: Senior Machine Learning Software Engineer, Research
description:
About us

Re-architecting Engineering for the Age of Intelligence

PhysicsX is the physics AI company for industrials. The company’s mission is to accelerate hardware innovation by overhauling what industrial engineering and manufacturing look like today. PhysicsX is building a new simulation software stack to deliver deep physics AI enablement across the entire engineering lifecycle. The company partners with leading organisations in aerospace & defence, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy & renewables, supporting them on some of their most critical and complex challenges. PhysicsX is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with offices in London, New York, and Singapore and an expanding presence in the Bay Area.

Note: We are currently recruiting for multiple positions across different levels, however please only apply for the role that best aligns with your skillset and career goals.

What you will do 

- Own the training stack end to end: experiment harness, sweeps, distributed training, checkpointing, and throughput.

- Implement and optimise model architectures with efficiency perspective: sparse attention and convolution, custom kernels, memory and precision work, and making a prototype fast enough to train at scale.

- Take architectural ideas from prototype to trained model, and own the ablations that establish whether a change actually helped.

- Set technical direction for the training stack, and build the inference and evaluation path that turns a checkpoint into something usable.

- Identify engineering investments that unlock research progress.

What you bring to the table 

- Senior-level experience in training machine learning models at scale, in industry or a research group of comparable intensity, instrumental in:

- distributed training with FSDP or equivalent, including profiling and diagnosing idle GPUs;

- PyTorch and CUDA at depth, ideally including sparse convolution or sparse attention internals and custom CUDA or Triton kernels;

- implementing architectures from papers and making them work, then making them fast;

- reproducible experiment infrastructure, because most of the compute in a programme like this is spent on runs that fail.

- Experience with 3D or other irregular data: meshes, point clouds, voxels, sparse tensors.

- Ability to scope and deliver projects, and strong problem-solving skills.

- Degree in CS, engineering, mathematics, physics or a related field. A PhD is welcome but not required; engineering depth matters more.

- Desirable: open-source contributions, public technical writing, or papers at MLSys, SIGGRAPH or CVPR

What we offer 

Build what actually matters 

Help shape an AI-native engineering company at a formative stage, tackling problems that genuinely matter for industry and society. This is work with real-world impact - and something you can be proud to stand behind.

Learn alongside exceptional people 

Work with a high-caliber, collaborative team of engineers, scientists, and operators who care deeply about doing great work, and about helping each other get better. We come from diverse backgrounds, but we share a commitment to operating at the highest level and addressing some of the most complex challenges out there. If you’re ambitious, thoughtful, and driven by impact, you’ll feel at home.

Influence over hierarchy 

We operate with a flat structure: good ideas win - wherever they come from. Questioning assumptions and challenging the status quo isn’t just welcomed, it’s expected.

Sustainable pace, long-term ambition 

Building meaningful technology is a marathon, not a sprint. We believe in balancing focused, ambitious work with a life beyond it. Our hybrid model blends time together in our Shoreditch office with work-from-home days, giving you the flexibility to work sustainably while staying connected in person.

And it doesn’t stop there … 

🚀 Equity options - share meaningfully in the company you’re helping to build.

🏦 10% employer pension contribution - because investing in future matters.

🍽️ Free office lunches - to keep you energised and focused.

👶 Enhanced parental leave - 3 months full pay paternity and 6 months full pay maternity leave, to provide extra flexibility during the moments that matter most.

🍼 YellowNest nursery scheme - to help working parents manage childcare costs.

☀️ 25 days of Annual Leave (+ Public Holidays) - because taking time to rest matters.

🏥 Private medical insurance - 100% employee cover, giving you complete peace of mind.

💪 Wellhub Subscription - gain access to thousands of gyms, classes and wellness apps, supporting both physical and mental wellbeing.

👀 Eye tests - because good work depends on good health.

📈 Personal development - dedicated support for learning, development, and leveling up over time.

💛 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) - confidential wellbeing support, available whenever you need it.

🚲 Bike2Work scheme and 🚆 Season ticket loan - to make getting to work easier and greener.

🚗 Octopus EV salary sacrifice - for a simpler, more sustainable way to drive electric.

🔎 Watch this space, we’re continuing to build this as we grow…

title: Senior ML Research Engineer, Virtual Cell
description:
About SandboxAQ 

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.

The Opportunity

The AI Sim R&D team builds leading-edge ML and physics-based models ("LQMs") to advance drug discovery. Within this team, AQCell is our virtual cell platform: it takes a cell representation (e.g. basal gene expression) and a perturbation descriptor (e.g. SMILES, dose, and time), predicts the resulting transcriptomic response, and maps that response through pathway activity to functional endpoints such as cell viability, IC50, and toxicity dose-response — helping drug discovery scientists understand the biological repercussions of a compound across the cell, not just whether it binds its target.

As a Machine Learning Engineer on AQCell, you will build and maintain the models and data infrastructure that power this pipeline. You will work across large, heterogeneous transcriptomic and functional-endpoint datasets (e.g. LINCS L1000, GDSC, Tahoe-100M, and DILImap), train and evaluate expression-perturbation and cell-viability prediction models over them, and help harden our evaluation pipeline and baselines so we can trust and improve model performance over time. This role sits at the intersection of machine learning and biology, and offers the opportunity to shape how virtual cell models are trained, validated, and scaled toward real drug discovery decisions.

Key Responsibilities

- Model Development: Build, train, and maintain machine learning models for expression-perturbation prediction (e.g. transcriptomic response to a drug perturbation) and downstream functional-endpoint prediction (e.g. cell viability, IC50, toxicity dose-response).

- Large-Scale Dataset Management: Acquire, harmonize, and manage large-scale biological datasets (e.g. LINCS L1000, GDSC, Tahoe-100M, DILImap) — including schema harmonization, normalization, and de-duplication across cell, drug, and assay identifiers — and manage model training pipelines over these pooled datasets.

- Evaluation & Baselines: Contribute to automating and hardening the end-to-end evaluation pipeline, including implementing robust statistical baselines (e.g. cell- and drug-conditioned mean baselines) to rigorously benchmark model performance.

- Research Translation: Translate ideas from the scientific literature (e.g. transformer-based perturbation models, knowledge graph and GNN-based embeddings) into working, well-tested code integrated into our modeling framework.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with computational biologists, software engineers, and product stakeholders to ensure models are grounded in sound biology and are usable in real drug discovery workflows.

- Communication: Clearly document methods, assumptions, and results, and communicate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Essential Skills & Experience

- Academic Foundation: Bachelor's degree in a scientific or quantitative field (Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, or related); an advanced degree (MS or PhD) is preferred.

- Applied ML in Science: Demonstrated experience building and maintaining machine learning models in a scientific discipline in an industry setting, including taking models from prototype through validation and maintenance; experience in a life sciences setting is preferred.

- Large-Scale Data Management: Required experience managing large-scale datasets and managing the training of models over them, including data ingestion, cleaning, versioning, and pipeline maintenance at scale.

- Software Engineering: Strong Python programming skills and experience with modern ML frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, JAX) and experiment tracking/data versioning tools (e.g. Weights & Biases).

- Scientific Rigor: Ability to design sound evaluation methodology (e.g. train/test splitting strategies, held-out generalization tests) and to critically interpret model performance against meaningful baselines.

Highly Desired Skills & Experience

- Bioinformatics & Computational Biology: Experience with bioinformatics and computational biology data analysis tools, particularly transcriptomics harmonization and normalization tools (e.g. batch correction, pseudobulking, gene ID mapping/standardization).

- Domain Datasets: Familiarity with public perturbation or drug-sensitivity datasets such as LINCS L1000, GDSC, DepMap, or single-cell perturbation atlases.

- Knowledge Graphs & GNNs: Experience with knowledge graph embeddings or graph neural networks applied to drugs, targets, or cells.

- Cheminformatics: Familiarity with cheminformatics representations (SMILES, InChI keys, PubChem/Cellosaurus identifiers) used to harmonize drug and cell metadata across datasets.

- Collaborative Innovation: Experience working in interdisciplinary environments where AI intersects with the biological sciences.

Why Join Us? 

We offer competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package, and opportunities for professional growth.

- Compensation: Competitive base salary, performance-based incentives or bonuses (where applicable), and equity participation.

- Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents with generous employer premium contributions, retirement savings with company matching, paid parental leave, and inclusive family-building benefits.

- Work-Life Balance: Flexible paid time off, company-wide seasonal breaks, and support for flexible work arrangements that enable sustainable performance.

- Career Development: Opportunities for continuous learning and growth through on-the-job development, cross-functional collaboration, and access to internal learning and development programs.

SandboxAQ Welcomes All 

We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging and respect, where diverse perspectives are actively sought and valued. Our multidisciplinary environment provides ample opportunity for continuous growth - working alongside humble, empowered, and ambitious colleagues ready to tackle epic challenges.

We're seeking passionate, innovative minds to join our journey. Be a part of our dynamic team and let's transform the industry together!

Director of Product, Workflows 

CreatorIQ is the software enterprise brands and agencies run their creator marketing programs on. A large customer works with thousands of creators a year across dozens of programs and several markets, and every one of those partnerships has to be sourced, vetted, agreed, briefed, tracked and paid for. You'll own that operational core and lead the product teams that cover it today, accountable for making the whole thing feel like one operation instead of a series of handoffs.

The mandate is to rebuild that operation around AI. Tooling in this category, ours included, was designed for a world where a person did each step by hand, and it still assumes that. It scales by adding people. A community manager keeping a 2,000-creator program on track lives in spreadsheets. An agency casting 300 creators against a brief in a week gets there by throwing bodies at it. Your job is to change what the software is responsible for, so programs scale without the headcount and the people running them spend their time on decisions that need judgment.

In this role, you’ll get to: 

- Own the workflow end to end. Discovery, Lists, Community, Campaigns and Messaging are one continuous job for our customers, and today they feel like separate products. Making them one, and making most of it happen without a human clicking through it, is the mandate.

- Lead and grow a team of product managers. You'll set the bar for how they work, coach them on discovery and judgment, and give them enough room to own their surfaces without you in the middle of every decision.

- Decide what gets rebuilt agentically, what gets simplified, and what gets deleted. Plenty of our existing workflow exists because someone needed a manual solution in 2020. Some of it should be automated, some should be replaced by a better model of the problem, and some should just go away.

- Get the trust model right. Provenance, confidence, human-in-the-loop review, honest failure, and clean rollback are what decide whether an enterprise customer lets an agent touch a live campaign.

- Partner with engineering and design leadership on architecture and delivery. Schema, core service, bulk operations, permissions, the data model that both the UI and the agents read from. You need to be credible in those conversations, not just present for them.

Who you are and what you’ll need for this position: 

- You've spent 8+ years in product, including 2+ leading product managers. Titles matter less than the work, but we need someone who has managed PMs before and knows the difference between coaching and taking over.

- You've owned a broad, workflow-heavy B2B SaaS surface where the product is the customer's daily job.

- You have a builder's mindset and haven't stopped being hands-on. You prototype. You use AI tools to build the thing rather than write a doc about the thing, and you expect the same from your team.

- You've rebuilt a manual workflow around AI and know the difference between removing the work and putting a chat box in front of the same twelve clicks. You're fluent in the mechanics too: retrieval, tool use, evaluation, human-in-the-loop review, and where an agent shouldn't be allowed to act alone.

- You have real product taste and you use it on AI output. You can look at an agent's plan, a generated brief, or a search result and say why it's good or why it's plausible-sounding filler. You ask the same question of a big customer's request or an inherited roadmap item: does this actually solve the problem?

- You're technical enough to hold your own on data model and API design. Schemas, CRUDL, bulk operations, permissions, third-party integrations. You can tell when a small-sounding request is touching something structural.

- You can prioritize across teams with genuinely competing claims and explain the tradeoff so the people who lost the argument still understand it.

- You write well. Most of how we work is async and in docs, and a Director who can only communicate in meetings will not scale here.

- You take initiative and own outcomes. You don't wait to be told the priority, and you'd rather bring a proposal than a list of questions. You're curious, self-driven, low-ego, and allergic to "that's not my job."

- Comfortable working with distributed teams across time zones. Most work is async and flexible, but occasionally we'll ask for a later call.

Nice to have 

- Experience with influencer marketing, creator workflows, or martech.

- Experience building search, discovery, or recommendation products, including semantic or multimodal search.

- Experience shipping CRM, relationship management, or lifecycle products.

- Experience shipping AI features into enterprise accounts where governance, auditability and permissions were part of the deal.

- Experience hiring product managers and building a team from a partial bench.

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Have 50% of the criteria? Excited about this opportunity? Passionate about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply! CreatorIQ is a place where everyone can grow.

What you will get from us:

- Work/life harmony: 25 days of vacation, floating and company holidays, wellness benefits, and paid parental leave.

Who we are: 

CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth, helping global brands and agencies transform creator marketing into an intelligence-driven growth engine. Powered by the Creator Graph™, which processes more than 250 million social posts daily across more than 15 million creators worldwide, CreatorIQ unifies fragmented platform data into a centralized intelligence layer and system of record for creator relationships, performance, governance, and commerce. More than 1,300 organizations—including Dentsu, Delta Air Lines, Google, Beiersdorf, Nestlé, and Wella—rely on CreatorIQ as the infrastructure to run and scale their creator programs globally. description:

Senior Fullstack Engineer (Go / Kotlin & React)

About the Team 

Merchant EMEA Engineering builds the technology that helps merchants join, grow, and operate successfully across our markets.

Our organization brings together the strengths of Wolt and Deliveroo and supports merchants across 37 countries. We work across the merchant journey, including onboarding, business growth and support, analytics and recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, and merchant applications.

Our teams sit close to the business. Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges.

📍This open role is based in our tech hubs in Helsinki or Berlin .

Please note: This role requires being based in Berlin/Helsinki on a hybrid basis. We are currently unable to offer fully remote work, visa sponsorship, or relocation support for this opportunity. 

What You'll Do 

As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll contribute to products and services used across the merchant experience. You'll:

- Build and maintain production software across backend services and user-facing applications.

- Work on areas such as merchant onboarding, analytics, recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, or merchant-facing tools.

- Develop reliable APIs, data models, services, and user-facing features.

- Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, operations, and other engineers to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.

- Own features from implementation through production and ongoing maintenance.

- Contribute to technical design discussions and improve the quality, scalability, observability, and maintainability of our systems.

- Use AI-assisted development tools effectively as part of your engineering workflow, while critically evaluating their output and taking ownership of the final solution.

- Be willing to work outside your primary area of expertise when needed to solve the problem end-to-end.

How We Work 

- Ownership: Engineers take responsibility for the features and services they work on, from development to production.

- Collaboration: We work closely across engineering, product, design, data, and operations.

- Pragmatism: We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity.

- Flexibility: We care more about solving the problem than strict frontend or backend boundaries.

Our Tech Stack 

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin , while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React .

We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.

Our Humble Expectations 

We're looking for engineers who have:

- An AI-first mindset, with a deep experience in leveraging modern AI tools and solid engineering principles to solve problems end-to-end, independently of any specific technology stack.

- Proven experience building production software in backend, frontend, or fullstack environments end-to-end and at scale.

- Strong expertise in at least one area of the stack, with a willingness to contribute outside that area when needed.

- Experience with a modern backend language such as Go, Kotlin, Java, or similar, and/or modern frontend technologies such as TypeScript and React.

- Good understanding of APIs, databases, testing, and software design fundamentals.

- The ability to work independently on well-scoped problems and collaborate effectively with others.

- Good communication skills and a pragmatic, collaborative mindset.

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend. We welcome different balances of experience. You might be primarily a backend engineer who is comfortable making frontend changes when needed, or a frontend-focused engineer who is happy to work with APIs and backend services.

What matters most is that you are comfortable working across boundaries to deliver the right solution.

Nice to Have 

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:

- Merchant-facing or internal operational tools.

- Analytics, recommendations, or decisioning systems.

- Grocery, retail, restaurants, logistics, or marketplace technology.

- Integrations with external business systems.

- Kafka or other streaming technologies.

- Cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Kubernetes, or Docker.

You'll work on products that directly affect how merchants interact with Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash across Europe. Strong analytical and financial acumen , with expertise in total cost of ownership (TCO) modeling, landed cost structures, and spend analytics.

title: Senior Branch Merchandiser
description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. The successful candidate will evolve and streamline the existing critical path — currently spread across multiple teams — into a cohesive approach to range planning, space planning, and allocation strategy, establishing clear processes across commercial functions. Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

- Trial and propose new ideas to move the business forward, including evolving allocation and replenishment systems for greater efficiency and accuracy.

- Potentialise sales and profit opportunities by store grade, using commercial analysis and data to unlock performance improvements across the estate.

- Develop and implement best practice distribution methods in partnership with merchandising and supply chain teams, optimising delivery frequency and stock flow.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

- Set commercial initial allocations by category aligned with planned store turnover, space, and cover, and implement and manage the seasonal allocation and replenishment strategy by department and category.

- Analyse and review weekly, monthly, and seasonal trade by store and grade versus budget and prior year, proposing short, medium, and longer-term corrective actions with pace and precision.

- Manage store openings, modernisations, closures, and space changes in close collaboration with Buying & Merchandising teams to deliver successful launches on time and on brief.

- Oversee the smooth flow of stock across stores, maximising potential through initial allocation, re-assortments, and end-of-season stock removal to Outlet.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY 

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:

- Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes

- Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance

- Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working

- Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING 

Required Qualifications: 

- Proven experience in a fast-paced Retail Merchandising or Space Planning role, ideally within a multi-site High Street or omnichannel retail environment.

- Strong commercial acumen with a deep understanding of store grading, range optimisation, space planning, and allocation and replenishment strategy.

- Excellent numerical and analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex trading data and translate it into clear, actionable recommendations.

- Demonstrated ability to influence and communicate effectively at all levels, including gaining buy-in from Senior Management on strategic decisions.

- Experience managing store openings, closures, or estate changes in collaboration with buying, merchandising, and logistics functions.

- A collaborative, cross-functional working style with the ability to build effective relationships across retail, B&M, logistics, and finance teams.

- Strong problem-solving skills and a solutions-focused mindset, with the ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure and deliver to deadlines.

WORK LOCATION 

Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in Manchester, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence 3 days per week. 

At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.

Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

Marketing at hx builds authority and demand in a niche, technically complex space. This isn't volume-driven marketing. It's deliberate, high-quality work where every output is expected to earn its place.

This role sits in Corporate Marketing: brand, content, flagship events, PR and comms, design and multimedia, and owned media. We partner with teams across the business to produce a high volume of long-form and short-form content. The opportunity now is to turn that into a repeatable operation. The pipelines that take a podcast episode or a report and turn it into clips, articles, exec posts and social. You'll help build those pipelines, run them day to day, and make each cycle better than the last.

It's an operations role rather than a strategy one. You'll be close to the editorial thinking and pick up plenty of it, but your job is the machinery that carries it.

Check out our Marketing & GTM Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining.

What you'll be doing 

Map how hx's content actually gets made. The tools, the sequence, the hand-offs, and where it breaks. Keep that picture current as the operation changes around it.

Run the production cycle across our content programmes (customer stories, the podcast, thought leadership and executive comms). Brief our agency partners, hold the quality bar on what comes back, and hit the publish dates. Take a growing share of that work in-house as you learn how it runs.

Draft copy for new web pages and projects. We draft with Claude against a codified brand voice, so you're never starting from blank. Work with input from internal SMEs and run the loop between programme owners, designers and agency partners. Brief in, feedback consolidated, builds QA'd, pages live on the date agreed.

Keep the hx thought leadership calendar operationally sound. Set the schedule, make the call on what runs when, chase the drafts, and cut existing long-form into the clips, posts and articles that feed our channels.

Keep the operations behind our named-voice programme running. The scheduling, the queue, the approvals, the chasing. So the experts and execs who carry our thought leadership post on cadence without having to manage the process themselves.

Build the templates, prompts and share packs the wider team publishes from. Good work shouldn't depend on you being available.

Learn how we stay visible in AI-generated answers as well as search results. Work out how that content gets published and distributed across the blog and website.

You'll start by running these cycles with support. Within a year we'd expect you to own them end to end and have a view on what we build next.

What we're looking for 

- You'll need to take on ownership and responsibility from the start, whatever your level. We care more about how you work than how long you've worked, and we don't expect you to have done all of this before.

- You've made and published something (a newsletter, a channel, a society page, client work) and found yourself more interested in how it got made than in the making.

- You're organised in a way other people can see. You track what's outstanding, you follow up, and you flag problems early rather than absorbing them.

- You use AI properly in your own work. Reusable prompts and templates that make a recurring task faster, not a tool you tried once.

- You pick things up by using them rather than waiting to be trained.

- Familiarity with a CMS, a scheduling tool, or a project tracker.

- Bonus points if you've got work out of someone you couldn't instruct (an agency, a freelancer, a collaborator) by writing a clear ask and going back when it wasn't right.

You're unlikely to thrive here if 

- You expect full product maturity, clear roadmaps, and well-defined processes before taking action - hx moves fast and requires comfort operating in ambiguity where products, priorities, and messaging are still evolving.

- You focus primarily on flashy launch work or brand campaigns rather than the detail-oriented, outcomes-driven work of deepening adoption, engagement, and user understanding.

- You struggle to prioritise or make trade-offs without perfect information, waiting for others to decide rather than using judgment to move work forward with the context available.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation 

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process. Our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations. We're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this.

Benefits

Additional perks

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Our commitment to Diversity 

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do. It's key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.
