We are looking for a Distinguished Leader to provide the overall technical leadership for our post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration programme, part of our quantum-safe product portfolio targeting hardware security module (HSM) and network-appliance applications. As the most senior technical authority of the programme, you will own the end-to-end architecture, from cryptographic algorithm and standards strategy to an FPGA-based product architecture with a clear path to ASIC, and you will set the technical direction across the cryptography, hardware, software and security disciplines involved. This is a rare opportunity to shape a strategic security product line at one of the few companies where quantum-safe security is the core business.

You will define the system architecture and microarchitecture of a multi-algorithm PQC accelerator implementing ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS: hardware/firmware partitioning, throughput and lane sizing derived from real customer traffic models, and a stable core-interface specification that lets cryptographic cores evolve behind a frozen contract. You are a recognised authority in your field, evidenced by shipped market-defining security products, contributions to standards, publications or patents, and you have taken accelerators, secure elements or HSM-class systems from specification to production more than once.

Over the past years, we've grown significantly, and we're now backed by NCSoft as our strategic shareholder, with ambitious plans to keep growing. As we scale, our finance function needs to scale with us, and we're looking for a (Senior) Controller who owns the numbers that steer our business: shareholder reporting, budget and forecast, and the KPIs leadership relies on every week. You will directly report to the Associate Director of Finance and you'll be the finance partner for our core revenue and cost drivers and help build a controlling function that scales with the company. This is a growth role: you'll start by mentoring our FP&A team member, and in the mid-term take over leadership of the controlling function.

Job responsibilities

- Shareholder reporting (NCSoft): Deliver the monthly management P&L and the quarterly consolidated balance sheet and P&L on time and in the shareholder's templates. Provide preliminary figures within a few days of month-end. Keep a clean bridge between management P&L and statutory figures.

- Budget and forecast: Own the annual budget and a rolling forecast. Turn the overhead budget into a working budget-control process, with cost-center owners, monthly actual-vs-budget reviews and follow-up actions.

- Business partnering: Be the finance counterpart for Revenue Generation / Ad Monetisation, User Acquisition, User Payments (payouts and rewards) and the G&A cost centers, with profitability as the focus.

- Cost control: Build levers and tracking for the largest cost blocks: personnel, SaaS, cloud, consulting, and payment fees (PayPal, FX).

- Analysis: Run variance analysis against budget, forecast and weekly flash, build scenario models, and prepare quarterly business reviews.

- Data integrity: Establish Metabase/Looker as a reliable source of finance KPIs. Reconcile BI data against invoices and the ledger, own the KPI definitions and remove double counts and manual add-ons.

- Liquidity: Work with Treasury on the liquidity forecast (network payout timing, UA spend, user cash-outs).

- Interface with accounting: Work with the Accounting Lead on the in-house month-end close, including accruals input, cut-off, and cost center and chart of accounts design in DATEV.

- Team: Mentor and review the work of our junior FP&A team member, and grow into the leadership of the controlling function in the mid-term.

Job requirements

- 6+ years in controlling or FP&A, with at least 2 years in a scale-up or digital B2C business; mobile apps, gaming or ad-tech is strongly preferred.

- Proven experience reporting to a corporate or strategic shareholder or a PE owner, including multi-entity consolidation and delivering to external templates under deadline.

- End-to-end ownership of a full budget and forecast cycle, including building driver-based models.

- Self-sufficient with data: hands-on with a BI tool (Metabase/Looker) and advanced Excel/Google Sheets

- Solid accounting foundation (accruals, FX, revenue recognition), with enough IFRS/HGB knowledge to reconcile management and statutory figures.

- Fluent English (written and verbal). German is a strong plus, given our work with PwC, DATEV and the local entities.

Nice-to-have

title: Graphene Process Development & Innovation Engineer (f/m/d)
description:

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. About our technology 

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role 

We are seeking an experienced Graphene Process Development & Innovation Engineer at Black Semiconductor to lead the development, integration, optimization, and manufacturing implementation of graphene transfer, lamination, patterning, and related wet processes for next-generation IGP™ devices.

This role combines graphene process development, equipment integration, wafer handling/lamination, wet processing, and manufacturing engineering. You will work across the technology lifecycle, from R&D and process development through equipment qualification, fab startup, production ramp-up, and sustained manufacturing.

You will work closely with Process Integration, Device, Equipment, Facilities, Metrology, Manufacturing, R&D, and external technology partners to develop reliable, scalable, and manufacturable graphene solutions.

- Develop scalable graphene process flows from R&D through qualification and manufacturing ramp-up.

- Troubleshoot process and equipment issues and lead root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement 

- Drive DOE, process characterization, data analysis, SPC, and process monitoring to improve yield, quality, reliability, and productivity.

- Establish and maintain PORs, process specifications, equipment specifications, recipes, process windows, and control plans.

- Analyze metrology and inspection data to identify process trends, defects, and improvement opportunities.

- Support fab startup, process/equipment qualification, production readiness, yield improvement, throughput, cycle-time improvement, and production ramp-up.

- Develop manufacturing procedures, work instructions, troubleshooting guides, and qualification documentation.

- Lead continuous improvement activities focused on yield, quality, throughput, equipment reliability, safety, and cost of ownership.

Collaboration & Technology Transfer

- Work with chemical, material, equipment, and technology suppliers to evaluate and qualify new solutions.

- Lead technical discussions with external partners, universities, research institutes, and equipment suppliers.

- Transfer process knowledge from R&D into manufacturing in a controlled and scalable manner.

- Support technician and engineer training for graphene processes and equipment.

Your Qualifications 

- Master's or Ph.D. degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, Semiconductor Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.

- 3+ years of semiconductor, advanced materials, advanced packaging, wafer processing, or related manufacturing experience.

- Strong experience in one or more of the following areas:

- Graphene or 2D-material processing and integration

- Graphene transfer and handling

- Wafer lamination, mounting, or tape application

- Thin-wafer handling

- Wet and chemical processing

- Advanced packaging or wafer-level manufacturing

- Semiconductor equipment development and integration

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

title: Senior SW Engineer – Embedded Linux SDK & Distribution (M/W/D)
description:
Mobileye is looking for a passionate Systems Software Developer to join the Operating System Team in the
EyeQ Platform Software Group. While many work on Linux, we work in Linux. Our team is responsible for the
core OS DNA of the EyeQ computer vision SoC, defining how the system starts, is composed, and manages its
lifecycle in a high-performance automotive environment.

We are looking for an experienced systems engineer to join our Core Distribution team . The center of this role
is the Linux userspace and the distribution itself: boot and service bring-up, root filesystem composition, and
the integration of external SDK into that platform. You will also build Python-based deployment tooling so the
OS and SDK stack can be provisioned reproducibly - infrastructure and tool development in service of the OS. 

What will your job look like 

- Architect and develop Linux userspace and service bring-up so the distribution boots into a consistent,
operational platform under embedded constraints.

- Enable and integrate an SDK into the OS image - drivers, libraries, runtimes, and filesystem layout as
first-class distribution components.

- Own distribution composition, including packages, sysroots, and image features that make the SDK and
core OS a maintainable, versioned platform.

- Develop Python-based deployment tooling to provision targets with a reproducible OS + SDK environment
(image delivery, flashing, and environment setup).

- Debug at the OS boundary - init/service failures, library and ABI mismatches, missing dependencies, and
SDK/runtime issues on the target.

- Perform root cause analysis on system-level failures in the distribution, from boot and userspace bring-up
through a fully operational stack.

- Collaborate on board bring-up, tailoring the distribution and SDK integration to new EyeQ generations and
related target hardware.

All you need is: 

- Outstanding graduate in Computer Science or similar field. 

- 5+ years of experience in Embedded Linux development, with a focus on systems software, userspace, or
distribution work.

- Strong C/C++ skills and a solid understanding of POSIX APIs, libraries, and how userspace talks to the
kernel.

- Deep knowledge of Linux Internals, specifically the boot process (Bootloaders, Kernel hand-off, Init
systems) and root filesystem layout.

- Hands-on experience with Embedded Linux Distributions (e.g., custom Yocto recipes, Buildroot, or
Linux-from-scratch).

- Experience enabling vendor SDKs or BSP stacks on Linux — integrating third-party drivers, runtimes, and
userspace components into a custom image.

- Proficiency in debugging tools like GDB, Valgrind, strace, and perf.

- Experience with Python for infrastructure and tool development — deployment, packaging, and
environment setup.

Nice to have: 

- Background in Automotive Software .\

- Experience with GPU/accelerator compute stacks (driver + userspace runtime, inference/compute
libraries, cross-sysroot workflows).

- Familiarity with reading hardware schematics and reasoning about basic hardware interfaces and signal.

Mobileye changes the way we drive, from preventing accidents to semi and fully autonomous vehicles. If you are an excellent, bright, hands-on person with a passion to make a difference come to lead the revolution!

Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow. 

Learn more about our Product & Tech team! 

Your mission Heartbeat AI is our energy optimisation platform that always provides our customers with the cleanest and cheapest energy. As Chief of Staff to the Go-to-Market Director, you are the operational backbone that keeps the go-to-market engine running at full speed across all markets. You own the details, the data, and the day-to-day execution, freeing the Go-to-Market Director to focus on strategy and the bigger picture, while you make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
- You own the operational rhythm of the Go-to-Market Director's agenda, translating strategic priorities into concrete plans, timelines, and next-day action items.
- You track performance data and KPIs across all markets, spotting issues early and surfacing clear, decision-ready insights before being asked.
- You bring structure to ambiguity, designing the project management architecture, systems, and processes that keep complex, multi-market initiatives moving without anything getting lost.
- You proactively identify what needs to happen next, take ownership of it end to end, and know when to bring in the Go-to-Market Director to support or guide.
- You prepare briefings, reports, and presentations that turn complex data into clear narratives for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
- You coordinate closely with Product, Tech, Sales, and Marketing across markets, following up on commitments and ensuring cross-functional initiatives stay on track.
- You act as a trusted right hand, representing the Go-to-Market Director's priorities accurately in conversations and correspondence.
- You constantly look for ways to improve how the Go-to-Market function operates, bringing structure and rigour to a fast-moving, scaling environment.

Your profile - You bring at least 3 to 5 years of experience in a Chief of Staff, business operations, analyst, or similar high-rigour role, ideally within tech, scale-ups, or energy. 

- You are exceptionally detail-oriented and accurate, with a natural instinct for catching what others miss. 

- You are proactive by nature: you don't wait to be told what to do, you anticipate what's needed, take initiative, and only ask for help or authority when it genuinely matters. 

- You have strong project management skills, able to build the architecture and structure that keeps complex, multi-market projects on track. 

- You are highly structured and organised by default, able to juggle multiple workstreams and deadlines without losing the thread. 

- You are strong with data and analytics, comfortable turning numbers into clear, actionable insight. 

- You are a fast, reliable executor who thrives on turning big-picture priorities into next-day, on-the-ground action. 

- Fluency in German and English (C1/C2) is required, written and verbal.

- With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate

- You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
- You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups

- Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass

title: Automation Engineer (gn) - 40 Std, (hybrid) (München)
description:
Deine Aufgaben ​ Wir arbeiten über ein zertifiziertes Netzwerk lokaler Handwerkspartner – ohne eigene Installationskapazitäten. Der Erfolg unseres Geschäftsmodells hängt direkt davon ab, wie gut wir dieses Partnernetzwerk aufbauen , auslasten und kommerziell steuern . Für diese zentrale Rolle suchen wir eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit , die unser Partnership Team leitet und gleichzeitig operativ in wichtige Verhandlungen mit Handwerkspartnern, OEMs und Großhandel eingebunden ist. Das Partnership Management ist eine Kernfunktion bei 42watt – zu deinen Aufgaben gehören: - Du treibst den deutschlandweiten Ausbau unseres Handwerkspartner-Netzwerks voran, gewinnst neue und entwickelst bestehende Partnerschaften weiter und schaffst damit die notwendigen Kapazitäten für das weitere Wachstum von 42watt. 

- Du verhandelst Preise, Projektvolumina, Kapazitäten und Rahmenbedingungen mit unseren Handwerkspartnern und stellst wirtschaftlich attraktive und langfristig erfolgreiche Partnerschaften sicher. 

- Du denkst Partnerschaften strategisch und kommerziell und entwickelst Incentivierungsmodelle, Partnerstufen und Prozesse , die Wachstum und wirtschaftlichen Erfolg für beide Seiten fördern. 

- Du verantwortest das Tendering unserer Projekte an das Partnernetzwerk und trägst damit maßgeblich zur Realisierung unseres kommerziellen Erfolgs bei (Revenue Operations). 

- Du bindest OEMs und Großhandel strategisch in unser Partner-Ökosystem ein und verbesserst kontinuierlich die Konditionen für 42watt und unsere Handwerkspartner. 

- Du entwickelst unser Partnernetzwerk datengetrieben weiter und steuerst es entlang von Kapazitätsbedarfen, regionaler Abdeckung, Auslastung sowie der Segmentierung und Entwicklung einzelner Partner. 

- Du entwickelst die relevanten KPIs und Steuerungsmechanismen , um Performance, Qualität und Wirtschaftlichkeit unseres Partnernetzwerks transparent zu machen und kontinuierlich zu verbessern. 

- Du führst und entwickelst unser Partnerships-Team , setzt klare Ziele und schaffst die Strukturen, mit denen das Team und unser Partnernetzwerk gemeinsam mit 42watt skalieren . 

Dein Profil - Erfahrung im Partner-/Account-Management: Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Partner- oder Account-Management mit (operativer oder Einkaufs-Schwerpunkt), idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden, dynamischen Umfeld. 

- Verhandlungsstärke: Du bist ein exzellenter Verhandler und hast nachweislich erfolgreich Preis-, Volumen-, Kapazitäts- und Rahmenvertragsverhandlungen geführt. 

- Kommerzielles Denken: Du verstehst die wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhänge hinter einem Partnernetzwerk und steuerst konsequent entlang von Umsatz, Marge, Kapazität und Auslastung. 

- Strategische Netzwerksteuerung: Du kannst ein wachsendes Partnernetzwerk strukturiert weiterentwickeln, Kapazitätsbedarfe frühzeitig erkennen und daraus konkrete Maßnahmen für Akquise, Entwicklung und Steuerung von Partnern ableiten. 

- Datengetriebene Steuerung: Du arbeitest sicher mit KPIs, leitest aus Daten konkrete Handlungsfelder ab und nutzt sie, um Performance und Wirtschaftlichkeit kontinuierlich zu verbessern. 

- Führungserfahrung: Du bringst Führungserfahrung in der Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung von Teams mit und schaffst klare Ziele, Verantwortlichkeiten und Strukturen. 

- Ownership & Hands-on-Mentalität: Du denkst strategisch, setzt aber genauso gerne selbst um – vom wichtigen Partnergespräch und der Verhandlung bis zur Verbesserung eines operativen Prozesses. 

- Scale-up-Mindset: Du fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem sich Strukturen schnell verändern, nicht jeder Prozess bereits definiert ist und Eigeninitiative gefragt ist. 

- Kommunikation: Du kommunizierst souverän mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern – vom Handwerksbetrieb über Großhandel und OEMs bis hin zu internen Führungskräften. 

- Sonstiges: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C2) und gute Englischkenntnisse und bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools und CRM-Systemen. 

- Nice to have: Ein tiefes Verständnis der Prozesse und Dynamiken im Handwerk (bevorzugt SHK oder Elektro), idealerweise erworben im Handwerksumfeld, Großhandel oder Partnermanagement. 

Unsere Benefits - Flexibel arbeiten: 2 Tage Home Office, 3 Tage im Büro und Vertrauensarbeitszeit geben dir Flexibilität und gleichzeitig eine klare gemeinsame Struktur.
- 30 Tage Urlaub + Workation: Neben 30 Urlaubstagen hast du an Heiligabend und Silvester jeweils einen halben Tag zusätzlich frei. Außerdem kannst du nach Absprache bis zu eine Woche pro Jahr aus der EU, dem EWR oder der Schweiz arbeiten.
- Company Bike: Lease dein Wunschrad oder E-Bike zu attraktiven Konditionen und nutze es auch privat. Rundum-Schutz ist inklusive. Optional kannst du auch ein zweites Bike für deine:n Partner:in leasen.
- 50 € monatlich on top: Du erhältst jeden Monat einen steuerfreien Benefit von 50 € bei mindestens 30 Std./Woche bzw. 25 € bei weniger als 30 Std./Woche. Den Betrag kannst du flexibel einsetzen.
- Rabatte & Vergünstigungen: Profitiere von zahlreichen Angeboten über das Corporate Benefits Portal und exklusiven Rabatten bei ausgewählten nachhaltigen Marken.
- Alles für deinen Arbeitsalltag: Ein MacBook der neuesten Generation, Call-Zones, Quiet-Zones und Phoneboxes bieten dir das passende Setup für konzentriertes Arbeiten. Kaffee aus der Siebträgermaschine, Getränke und frisches Obst stehen ebenfalls für dich bereit.
- Zeit fürs Team: Zweiwöchentliches Breakfast, Afterwork Drinks, Sommerfest oder Weihnachtsfeier. Wir schaffen regelmäßig Gelegenheiten, um auch abseits des Arbeitsalltags gemeinsam Zeit zu verbringen.

Gleiche Chancen für alle Bei 42watt leben wir eine offene und inklusive Unternehmenskultur. Wir sind überzeugt, dass Diversität und Gleichberechtigung der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg sind. Deshalb schaffen wir ein Arbeitsumfeld, das Chancengleichheit fördert und Vielfalt auf allen Ebenen unterstützt. title: Senior Asset Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Firmenprofil Unser Mandant ist ein erfolgreiches, inhabergeführtes Immobilienunternehmen mit einem breit diversifizierten Gewerbeimmobilienportfolio und langjähriger Marktpräsenz. Im Fokus stehen die nachhaltige Entwicklung, strategische Steuerung und Wertsteigerung von Immobilienbeständen in attraktiven Wirtschaftsregionen. Durch unternehmerisches Denken, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine langfristige Perspektive entstehen Freiräume für innovative Ideen und eigenverantwortliches Handeln. Mitarbeitende erhalten die Möglichkeit, aktiv auf die Entwicklung von Immobilien und Geschäftsstrategien Einfluss zu nehmen. Eine wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur, gepaart mit hoher Professionalität und Stabilität, bildet die Grundlage des gemeinsamen Erfolgs.

Ihre Aufgaben - Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium mit immobilienwirtschaftlichem, betriebswirtschaftlichem oder kaufmännischem Schwerpunkt beziehungsweise eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Asset Management von Gewerbeimmobilien auf Eigentümerseite mit nachweisbaren Erfolgen im Vermietungs- und Wertschöpfungsmanagement.
- Fundierte Kenntnisse der Assetklassen Büro und Logistik sowie ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für gewerbliche Immobilienmärkte.
- Souveränes Auftreten kombiniert mit Verhandlungsgeschick, Abschlussstärke und hoher Beratungskompetenz.
- Unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit mit analytischer Stärke, belastbarem Netzwerk und ausgezeichnetem kaufmännischem Verständnis.
- Strategische Weiterentwicklung und aktive Steuerung eines anspruchsvollen Gewerbeimmobilienportfolios mit direktem Einfluss auf Wertentwicklung und Performance.
- Entwicklung innovativer Nutzungs- und Vermietungsstrategien zur nachhaltigen Optimierung von Bestands- und Neubauimmobilien.
- Führung von Mietvertragsverhandlungen sowie Begleitung komplexer Vermietungsprozesse von der Erstansprache bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.

title: Product Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Description We are seeking a product manager to own the "what" and "why" of our quantum sensing measurement systems. You turn customer and market needs into clear product requirements that engineering can turn into specifications, and you own the roadmap for the QDm product line, starting with QDm.1. You sit between our customers (foundries, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs) and every engineering discipline, and you make sure we build the right product in the right order. 

Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join us? Picture this: 
- Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.
- Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.
- Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.
- An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.
Still unsure about why joining us? 
- You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.
- From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.
- Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.
- You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.
Let’s make the invisible visible! 

What will you do - Own the product requirements: gather needs from customers, the field, the market, and internal stakeholders (serviceability, modularity and product configuration, manufacturability, and cost targets), and turn them into clear, prioritized, solution-neutral requirements.
- Establish our requirements engineering tooling and workflow: select and set up how we capture, trace, and maintain requirements, from customer need through specification to verification, including change control across releases. This is a foundational task in your first months.
- Own and maintain the QDm.1 roadmap: propose what gets built and in what order, make the trade-offs explicit, and align decisions with the management team.
- Work with the applications team on customer interactions and evaluations with fabs, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs, and translate what you learn into requirements.
- For each requirement, define acceptance criteria from the customer's point of view so it is clear and testable when the need is met, and link them to customer evaluation and qualification plans.
- Align with the Product Development department on scope and timing, and hand solution-neutral requirements into engineering: state the need and the why, and leave the how to the disciplines.
- Support go-to-market: give input on positioning, pricing, launch readiness, and documentation scope together with the applications, operations, and product development teams.

What is expected of you - Several years in product management for complex hardware or capital equipment, ideally in semiconductor, metrology, or a comparable deep-tech environment.
- A track record of writing clear product requirements that engineering can actually build from.
- The ability to talk to both customers and engineers and to translate between them.
- Enough technical depth to hold a credible conversation with the people designing the product, across mechanics, optics, electronics/RF, and software.
- Structured prioritization: you make trade-offs explicit and back them with reasoning.
- We hire for demonstrated skill rather than a specific degree; a technical or scientific background is typical. The working language is English.
Additional experience we value: 
- Semiconductor industry knowledge (fabs, IDMs, OSATs, inspection, metrology, or failure analysis).
- Familiarity with SEMI standards and fab tool integration (for example, S2/S8, E10, SECS/GEM).
- Experience selecting or setting up a requirements management tool (for example, Jama, Polarion, or CodeBeamer).
- A working understanding of quantum sensing, optics, or precision instrumentation.

Our benefits - Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.
- Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.
- Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.
- Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.
- Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.
- Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.
- Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

title: Account Executive SMB | UK Market (m/f/d)
description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath. 

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide , from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day .

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people , profitable , and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

In this role, you'll own the full sales cycle in the UK market. You'll handle warm inbound enquiries while proactively prospecting new leads yourself, book and run demo calls, and guide the process through to successful close. You'll also support technical implementation to ensure new customers get off to a strong start. 

Who We Want 

2-3 years of B2B sales experience.
You've worked in B2B sales for several years and know the full sales cycle first-hand, from prospecting to close.

Self-confident.
You believe in your ability to run and close a conversation without coming across as arrogant.

Self-starter.
You build your own pipeline instead of waiting for inbound leads, and use a quiet week to prospect even harder.

Coachable.
You take direct feedback without getting defensive, and visibly apply it in your next conversation.

Resilient.
You bounce back quickly from a lost deal or a tough week and keep your activity levels consistently high.

Fast learner.
You get up to speed on a technical product quickly and can explain it to customers in a way they understand.

Structured .
You keep your pipeline clean and your CRM notes reliable, without anyone having to chase you.

Strong communicator .
You're a native English speaker with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Who We Don't Want 

Waits for leads to be handed over. 
You rely on inbound or leads being assigned to you, and can't or won't proactively build your own pipeline.

Gets defensive with feedback. 
You take direct feedback personally instead of applying it, and repeat the same mistakes call after call.

Weak written communication. 
You struggle to express yourself clearly and professionally in writing, whether that's emails, CRM notes, or follow-ups.

In it for the paycheck alone. 
You're chasing the salary with no genuine interest in the craft of selling, and it shows in how little curiosity you bring to the work.

Your Day To Day 

Demos & Product Presentation (~80%)

- You convince prospects to join a product demo and book the relevant appointments

- You present Superchat's capabilities convincingly and show customers how the product solves their specific challenges

Lead Sourcing & Prospecting (~10%)

- You generate new pipeline independently, regardless of inbound leads, and identify the right target customers in the UK market

Closing (~10%)

- You convince prospects to sign a contract and successfully guide the sales cycle through to close

Stakeholders 

Customers : your most important point of contact day-to-day - from first outreach through demos to close
Sales Team: for joint training, knowledge-sharing, and exchanging best practices across the sales cycle
Customer Success Team : for handover after a successful close and a smooth start to onboarding

Why People Choose Us 

- We believe in the power of in-person collaboration: We're an in-office culture at heart - we genuinely love being together in the Berlin office. That's where the best ideas happen, decisions move faster, and we learn from and grow with each other every day. We do offer some flexibility for remote work, but our default and our energy is being in the room together.

- We're an international team with diverse cultural backgrounds and languages. Openness, mutual respect, and the exchange of different perspectives shape the way we work together.

- We value ambition and drive. We're looking for people who take ownership, show initiative, and are excited to grow quickly.

- We work with a high degree of ownership and a strong learning mindset. Asking questions, staying curious, and continuously improving are part of our everyday culture.

- We care deeply about humility and teamwork. No egos, open feedback, and a willingness to learn from one another matter more to us than titles.

Benefits & Culture 

- Choose between an Urban Sports Club or John Reed membership, or a public transport pass/Dance subscription.

- Regular company-wide and team events.

- An annual €500 learning and development budget that you can use for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more.

- An inclusive and exciting startup culture that supports rapid professional and personal growth.

- A beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment.

We want to build a community, not just a company. 

Creating an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together is important to us - whether that's through HYROX training, golf, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or any other community you'd like to build here.

We believe that diversity makes companies stronger. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of gender, background, nationality, or religion. Feel free to apply - we'd love to hear from you! 

By submitting your application, you agree to our Privacy Policy. 

We look forward to receiving your application! 🙂

title: Software Engineer (M/W/D) – AI-Native Development
description:
Was wir tun

Als IoT Pioniere entwickeln wir mit über 40 Kollegen*innen an drei Standorten IoT-Komplettlösungen für unsere Kunden. 
Aktuell sind weltweit über 500.000 Geräte und Anlagen mit unseren Lösungen für Machine-to-Machine-Kommunikation ausgestattet.

Unsere Kompetenz liegt in der Entwicklung kundenspezifischer IoT-Lösungen, basierend auf unserer Erfahrung, unseren erprobten Software-Bausteinen und einer Vielzahl von bereits realisierten Projekten.

Unser Team

Seit der Firmengründung im Jahr 2004 sind wir stetig gewachsen und haben uns in diesem Markt über die Jahre als starker Partner etabliert. 
Damit das auch so bleibt, erweitern wir kontinuierlich unser Team mit talentierten und qualifizierten Entwickler*innen.
Durch vielseitige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Teilnahme an Konferenzen und Workshops sowie eine ausgeprägte Feedback-Kultur heben wir unser Team auf die nächste Stufe.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine(n) Fullstack Software Engineer (M/W/D) an den Standorten GARBSEN (bei Hannover), BISSENDORF (bei Osnabrück) oder Berlin 

Deine Aufgaben

Du willst nicht nur Features abarbeiten, sondern Anwendungen als Ganzes verstehen, gestalten und weiterentwickeln?

Bei der INSIDE M2M GmbH entwickelst du anspruchsvolle Softwarelösungen für unsere IoT-Plattform. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt in Java und Quarkus – und du entwickelst den Fluss durchgängig bis ins Angular-Frontend mit TypeScript.

KI-gestützte Coding-Tools und Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Handwerk, nicht zum Hype. Du setzt sie souverän ein, bewertest ihre Ergebnisse kritisch und verantwortest Qualität, Sicherheit und Wartbarkeit deines Codes.

- Du entwickelst robuste Backend-Services in Java und Quarkus – von der Architektur über APIs bis zur produktiven Nutzung. 

- Du arbeitest an der dazugehörigen Angular-Anwendung mit TypeScript und gestaltest die Schnittstellen zwischen Backend und Frontend mit.

- Du integrierst KI-gestützte Coding-Tools und Coding Agents fest in deinen Workflow.

- Du bringst dich in Architekturentscheidungen, Code Reviews und die Verbesserung unserer Entwicklungsprozesse ein.

- Du arbeitest eng mit deinem Team, unseren Kunden und weiteren technischen Ansprechpartnern zusammen.

Das bringst du mit

- Mehrjährige Praxis in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung.

- Ausgeprägte Praxis in Java und Quarkus sowie gute Kenntnisse in Angular und TypeScript im Frontend.

- Vertrautheit mit REST-APIs, Datenbanken und ORM.

- Erfahrung mit automatisierten Tests, inklusive E2E-Testing.

- Nachweisbare Praxis mit AI-Coding-Workflows – z. B. mit Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot oder vergleichbaren Tools. Du kannst erklären, welche Prompts, Setups und Guardrails bei dir funktionieren – und wo die Grenzen liegen.

- Gutes Gespür für Softwarearchitektur, Codequalität und langfristig wartbare Lösungen.

- Eine eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift – für die Zusammenarbeit mit Team und Kunden zwingend erforderlich.

- Gute Englischkenntnisse für technische Dokumentationen und internationale Tools.

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss

- Hintergrund in der Entwicklung oder Weiterentwicklung einer IoT-Plattform

- Erfahrung mit verteilten Systemen, Gerätedaten, Messaging oder technischen Schnittstellen

- Kenntnisse in Docker, Kubernetes und Cloud-native Development

- Vertrautheit mit CI/CD, Observability oder Platform Engineering

Klingt nach dir?

Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen. Erzähl uns gerne, an welchen Softwarelösungen du bisher gearbeitet hast und wie du KI-gestützte Werkzeuge in deinem Alltag einsetzt.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung bei INSIDE M2M

Your tasks

title: AI Transformation Architect
description:
About Dialpad 
Dialpad is the AI platform for customer experience, built to resolve customer problems in real time across voice and digital. Our AI agents learn from your best human agents and improve with every interaction, helping organizations understand their customers, deliver better experiences, increase operational efficiencies, and build a lasting competitive advantage. 

Unlike legacy systems built to route and answer, or standalone agentic bot vendors built to deflect, Dialpad was built to resolve. Our AI agents and human agents operate on a single platform with shared context, allowing Agentic AI to resolve issues, advance deals, and eliminate busywork through automation while seamlessly handing conversations to humans when needed, with full context preserved. 

Market-leading brands, including Randstad, Motorola Solutions, Netflix, the San Diego Padres, the Colorado Rockies Baseball Club, and Cal Athletics, trust Dialpad. Dialpad is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, GV, ICONIQ Capital, and T-Mobile.

We look for people who are intensely curious and hold themselves to a high bar. Our ambition is significant, and achieving it requires a team that operates at the highest level. We seek individuals who embody our core traits: Scrappy, Curious, Optimistic, Persistent, and Empathetic . 

Your role
The primary purpose of our AI Transformation Architect team is to accelerate the adoption and realization of value from our AI platform by embedding within our most strategic customer accounts. You will be the crucial link that translates complex business challenges into validated, high-impact Agentic AI solution designs, driving business outcomes. AI Transformation Architects will act as the company's most technically fluent business consultant and the customer's most trusted AI architects throughout the presales motion. 

What you'll do 

- Business Translation and Discovery: Rapidly embed with customer stakeholders and operational leaders to deeply understand their most complex, high-stakes business problems. Translate ambiguous business objectives into clear, Agentic AI solutions. 

- The Go-To-Market Bridge: Partner directly with our Sales, Sales Engineers, Professional Services, and Customer Success teams to serve as the deep technical authority during critical pre-sales evaluations. You don't just sell the vision; you create technical validation through strategic AI workshops and Proofs of Concept. 

- Product Alignment and Influence: Capture common customer pain points, successful integration patterns, and platform limitations discovered in the field. Synthesize and deliver this critical, high-value signal directly back to our core Product and Engineering teams to influence the product roadmap and accelerate feature development. 

- AI Envisioning: Navigate complex enterprise infrastructure (cloud, on-prem, data pipelines) to scope integration feasibility. Guide customers through their Agentic AI evaluation, advising and prototyping integration and custom data connectors, orchestration logic, and full-stack systems that bring AI to life. 

- Agentic AI Discovery: Discover and advise complex multi-agent systems, architectures, and fine-tuned models tailored to the customer's unique data, domain, and security requirements during the presales motion. As part of AI envisioning workshops, demonstrate feasibility of multi‑step prompts, retrieval pipelines, and decision logic that plug into CRMs, ERPs, and custom APIs via our MCP framework. 

Skills you'll bring 

- 4+ years of experience in a high-impact, customer-facing technical role such as AI Architect, Technical Consulting, high touch Sales Engineering or Solutions Architecture, or technical consulting for SaaS/AI products. 

- Deep, demonstrable expertise in the modern AI/ML stack: LLMs, Generative AI concepts, vector databases, and agent orchestration frameworks. Proficiency in Python, Go, JS/TS plus hands‑on experience with LLM frameworks. 

- Unrivaled Business Acumen: The ability to simplify technical complexity and communicate clear trade-offs, value propositions, and project plans to both a core engineering team and a non-technical C-suite executive. 

- You thrive in ambiguity, take full ownership of outcomes, and are driven by delivering tangible, measurable results for the customer, often working under tight timelines. 

- Contributor to a dynamic team culture, focused on high growth industry innovation, team collaboration, customer success, and having fun! 

Why Join Dialpad 

- Work at the center of the AI transformation in business communications 

- Build and ship agentic AI products that are redefining how companies operate 

- Join a team where AI amplifies every employee’s impact 

- Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and real opportunities for growth 

We believe in investing in our people. Dialpad offers competitive benefits and perks, cutting-edge AI tools, and a robust training program that help you reach your full potential. We have designed our offices to be inclusive, offering a vibrant environment to cultivate collaboration and connection. Our exceptional culture, repeatedly recognized as a Great Place to Work , ensures that every employee feels valued and empowered to contribute to our collective success. 

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role and possess the fundamental traits, drive, and strong ambition we seek, but your experience doesn’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply. 

Dialpad is an equal-opportunity employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment.

About the opportunity 👇

Senior Product Manager, PLG & Onboarding 

About the role 

Exclaimer is the leading email signature management vendor. Our product appeals to companies who need their employees’ emails to include disclaimers and signatures with consistent branding.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own our product-led growth (PLG) motion, with a particular focus on the self-serve onboarding flow on www.exclaimer.com: the path a new user takes from signup through activation, to their first meaningful "aha" moment during a trial, to becoming a paying customer.

You’ll be working closely with our Head of PLG, with whom you agree improvements to the onboarding flow. Your impact on activation and time-to-value translates directly into revenue, retention, and lower cost of acquisition.

- Own the self-serve funnel end to end – the initial focus is on signup, activation and first-value.

- Partner with sales and customer success on clean handoffs for accounts that need a human touch.

- Contribute to pricing and packaging – the structure of our packages, feature gating, paywalls, and upgrade triggers.

- Talk to users constantly - usability testing, interviews, session replay, and support/NPS signal - to find where self-serve users get stuck.

- Report on PLG health to leadership, translating funnel data into a clear narrative and a prioritised action plan.

What you'll bring 

Experience

- You are an experienced product manager, who has owned and improved a PLG motion or self-serve onboarding/activation funnel at a B2B SaaS company.

- A track record of moving a specific metric - activation rate, time-to-value, trial-to-paid conversion - and can speak to the before/after in detail.

- Experience running structured experimentation at a meaningful cadence, not one-off tests.

- Experience working cross-functionally with design, engineering, data, marketing, and sales/CS.

Skills & ways of working

- Data fluency – comfortable using data tools (Tableau, Databricks, Heap), with an inquisitive mind, drawing sound conclusions and making data-informed decisions.

- Product craft - strong UX instincts and a close working relationship with design; can review a Figma flow and know what will confuse or delight a new user.

- Systems thinking - sees the funnel as an integral part of the overall product and customer experience.

- Commercial acumen - understands how pricing, packaging, and monetisation levers interact with activation and conversion.

- Technical fluency and AI - can talk credibly with engineers about implementation trade-offs without needing to write the code. Is able to build AI into their workflows and to continuously seek ways to improve velocity and quality.

- Communication - writes clearly, prioritises ruthlessly, and can bring stakeholders along with objective arguments and a clear point of view.

- Collaboration and continuous learning – works well with geographically dispersed colleagues from a range of disciplines to achieve a common goal. Helps others improve their game by giving constructive feedback. Believes in continuous learning.

For some customers, "close" means embedded. You're effectively part of their engineering team, in their Slack, on their calls, building alongside them. The platforms you'd be embedded with have hundreds of millions of users between them. When you fix something, it's not hypothetical. It's live, that day.

- Enable customer teams. Run technical workshops, document what you build, and give customers the knowledge and tools to operate successfully without us in the room.

- 4-8 years as a software engineer, solutions engineer, or in a similar role in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

The role directly reports to the Network Engineering team as a principal technical lead and acts as a dedicated support the Head of Connectivity as the primary technical authority for backbone architecture. As Principal Network Architect, Backbone Connectivity, you will own the technical architecture of Firmus's backbone network and act as the principal technical adviser to the Head of Connectivity, while operating as a senior technical lead within the Network Engineering team. You will convert the Firmus Connectivity Strategy into an integrated, executable backbone architecture spanning subsea and terrestrial fibre, optical transport (DWDM/OTN), IP/MPLS and segment routing, data-centre interconnection and partner connectivity. You will define the reference architecture, standards and reusable design patterns that guide engineers and partners, ensuring every AI Factory and Firmus AI Cloud service attaches through resilient, diverse and scalable backbone nodes free of unmanaged common-mode failure. 

Working across carriers, subsea operators, terrestrial fibre providers and data-centre partners, you will set minimum resilience profiles, validate physical-route and shared-risk-link-group diversity, and provide independent technical assurance that designs can be delivered, operated and scaled safely across their full lifecycle. You will act as technical design authority in vendor and technology selection for backbone and subsea services, lead complex backbone changes and cutovers, mentor the engineering team, and benchmark Firmus's designs against leading global operators and hyperscalers — keeping Firmus at the forefront of AI-ready network connectivity.

You are, first and foremost, an accomplished network architect for large-scale, mission-critical connectivity infrastructure. You are fluent in optical transport (DWDM/OTN, coherent and client-side optics, ROADM and amplification/regeneration planning) and in IP backbone design, including IP/MPLS, segment routing, EVPN, traffic engineering, peering, transit and internet exchange, and high-capacity data-centre and customer interconnection. You understand how to design resilient, diverse networks free of unmanaged common-mode failure, using SRLG analysis, engineered failure-state capacity and physical-route evidence to prove your claims rather than assert them.

You are comfortable engaging carriers, subsea consortia, internet exchanges and major equipment vendors, and you can drive value engineering and sustainability outcomes without compromising resilience or performance.

title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Training - UK
description:
Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week

Check out this Loom video for more details: https://www.loom.com/share/b0d1b0bf24c44ae8b95dca84b9db60e5 

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is 

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

• Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

• Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

• Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing 

• Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end

• Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think

• Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code

• Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)

• Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading

• Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste" 

We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

• Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

• Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

• Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

• Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

Who you are 

• Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)

• Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python

• Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor

• Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows

• Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line

• Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement

• Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback

• High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have 

• Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows

• Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details 

• Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

• Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well

• Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat

• Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. No interview

title: Marketing Manager, Europe
description:
About Andela: 

At Andela, we know brilliance is evenly distributed around the world, but opportunity is not. For over 12 years, Andela has connected its customers with top global, remote technical talent from over 135 countries with the majority residing in emerging markets like Africa and Latin America.

As one of the world’s largest talent marketplaces, Andela gives companies greater flexibility to quickly deploy qualified technologists. With talent highly skilled in advanced technologies to support Application Development, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud & DevOps, Data Engineering, and much more, customers experience 33% faster project delivery. The company’s exclusive AI-powered platform, Andela Talent Cloud , is the industry’s only unified platform managing the complete global talent lifecycle and enables customers to fill individual roles or engage fully managed teams up to 66% faster.

Andela is on the precipice of two breakout industry transformations: one in staffing/hiring and the other in software development, both accelerated by generative AI.

Are you exceptional and hungry to work in a scaling business through transformation and growth? Join us and change the world.

Job Summary 

As the Marketing Manager, Europe, you will be responsible for designing and executing the programs that build pipeline, strengthen brand presence, and accelerate revenue across the region. You will own end-to-end regional marketing strategy with a heavy emphasis on field events, account-based marketing (ABM), and pipeline generating campaigns that directly support the European sales team.

You will operate as a collaborative partner to specialized marketers across Andela's global team — including growth, content, design, PR, and client marketing— bringing their capabilities to bear in the European market context. This role reports into the Senior Director of Marketing GTM Strategy and is based in the UK within a commutable distance to London.

Exceptional Leadership 

As an Andelan, you'll serve as a role model for the rest of the company — you do not need to manage people to be a leader at Andela! Think about the feedback your peers typically give you — if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you.

- Low ego, low drama : You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea.

- Onedela mentality : You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone.

- Great listener, hungry for feedback : You’re always seeking to improve – our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen.

- Owner, not renter : You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you.

- Cultivator: You enrich, you push, you make others grow. It comes from the heart, because you care.

Key Responsibilities 

Regional Event Strategy & Execution 

- Own the end-to-end planning and execution of European field events — including owned events, sponsored industry conferences, roundtables, and executive dinners — aligned to pipeline and revenue goals.

- Build and maintain a European events calendar, managing logistics, vendor relationships, budget, and post-event follow-up to ensure measurable ROI.

- Partner with the sales team to ensure event audiences reflect target account lists, and that every event ties to a clear pipeline outcome.

- Track and report on event performance including attendee quality, influenced pipeline, and cost-per-opportunity.

Account-Based Marketing (ABM) 

- Partner with the Growth Marketing team to design and execute ABM programs targeting high-priority European accounts in collaboration with sales leadership.

- Use account intelligence to both inform campaigns and support the regional sellers.

- Measure ABM effectiveness at the account level, reporting on account engagement, pipeline created, and influenced revenue.

Pipeline Generation & Demand Generation 

- Own regional pipeline contribution targets, developing programs that generate qualified opportunities for the European sales team.

- Build and execute integrated campaigns — across email, paid, content, and events — that move target accounts through the funnel.

- Partner with the global Growth Marketing team to localize and adapt global campaigns for the European market, including messaging, channels, and timing.

- Maintain a consistent drumbeat of regional campaigns, adapting quickly based on performance data and sales feedback.

Sales & Cross-Functional Partnership 

- Act as the primary marketing partner to the European sales team, building a close working relationship with sales leadership to align on pipeline goals, target accounts, and priorities.

- Collaborate with content, digital, and brand teams to pull global resources into regional execution — you are a multiplier, not a solo function.

- Provide European market insights, competitive intelligence, and buyer feedback to inform global marketing strategy and messaging.

- Work with the Revenue Operations team to develop regionally relevant sales enablement materials and outreach.

Reporting & Optimization 

- Track, analyze, and report on regional marketing performance against brand awareness, pipeline, engagement.

- Continuously test and iterate on program approaches, applying data-driven insights to improve outcomes over time.

Qualifications 

Experience 

- 4-6 years of B2B marketing experience, with a strong track record in field marketing, events, or demand generation roles, ideally within a high-growth technology company.

- Demonstrated experience running field events end-to-end — from strategy and planning through to execution and post-event reporting.

- Hands-on experience building and executing ABM programs, including target account selection, campaign orchestration, and measurement.

- Experience working closely with sales teams and an understanding of how marketing contributes to the revenue funnel.

- Prior experience in the European market.

- Experience working across time zones as part of a global team.

Skills & Capabilities 

- Strong project management skills — able to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines simultaneously with a high degree of organization and attention to detail.

- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret campaign data, draw actionable insights, and present results clearly to stakeholders.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt messaging for different audiences and channels.

Location 

- While Andela is a fully remote organization, this role should be based in the United Kingdom within a commutable distance to London to accommodate regular team in-person working sessions.

- Some travel across Europe required for events and meetings.

CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com . 

We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

What You’ll Do: 

The Data Center Security Risk & Assurance Senior Program Manager drives the maturity and execution of CoreWeave’s data center physical security controls compliance program. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Data Center Risk and Assurance, this role ensures that all Data Center Security designs, controls, and operational practices tied to the company’s audit and customer requirements across CoreWeave’s global data center footprint meet defined security standards, regulatory requirements, and organizational expectations. This role will also support new site selection, physical security due diligence, and initial risk evaluation for the EMEA region.

This Program Manager will own the Data Center Security-specific audit framework, oversee comprehensive risk and assurance audits within our operations sites, and partner closely with Security Design, Operations, Legal, and Engineering teams to validate adherence to CoreWeave and its partners’ security objectives. The role requires a strategic thinker with an understanding of physical and operational audit scope, an eye for control assurance, scalability, and strong cross-functional influence in a fast-growing, high-performance environment.

About the role: 

- Represent CoreWeave’s Data Center Security Operations team, ensuring all DC Security controls and processes align with internal standards, customer contractual requirements, and external regulatory frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, etc.).

- Audit & Assessments: Plan and lead independent internal audits and control validations across CoreWeave’s data center network; deliver actionable findings and track remediation, ensuring timely treatment.

- Operational Assurance: Partner with Data Center Operations, Security Design, Security Operations, and Technical Program Management teams to verify that physical security controls are implemented, maintained, and effective.

- Site Selection Due Diligence: Conduct physical security due diligence for site selection, ensuring appropriate security requirements are included in Master Service Agreements and other lease contracts, collaborating with Site Selection and Legal teams. 

- Post Lease or Build Contract Execution: This role informs and collaborates with the Security Design and Security Operations teams to communicate site security requirements.

- Metrics and Reporting: Ensure assessments and audit evidence are managed and reported in accordance with CoreWeave controls compliance mechanisms to track control health, audit outcomes, and risk trends.

- Collaboration & Influence: Build strong relationships with internal partners, fostering a culture of accountability and proactive risk management throughout the data center lifecycle.

- Emerging Risk Monitoring: Stay current with evolving threat landscapes, compliance standards, and industry best practices to ensure CoreWeave’s data center security programs remain resilient and forward-looking.

Who You Are: 

- 5+ years of experience in security risk management, compliance, or assurance functions, ideally within cloud, hyperscale, or critical infrastructure environments.

- Proven success leading risk audits and assurance programs in complex, high-growth organizations.
Strong understanding of physical and logical security controls, risk frameworks (NIST CSF, ISO 27001, ISO22237, ISO22301, SOC 2, HITrust, FedRAMP), and data center operational security.

- Demonstrated ability to translate technical security concepts into actionable business insights and governance structures.

- Excellent communication, influencing, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Relevant certifications or on-the-job experience (CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor) preferred.

Why Us? 

We work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

- Be Curious at Your Core 

- Act Like an Owner 

- Empower Employees 

- Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences 

- Achieve More Together 

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us! 

The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results. 

What We Offer 

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:

- Family-level Medical Insurance

- Family-level Dental Insurance 

- Generous Pension Contribution 

- Life Assurance at 4x Salary 

- Critical Illness Cover 

- Employee Assistance Programme 

- Tuition Reimbursement

- Work culture focused on innovative disruption

Benefits may vary by location. 

Equal Opportunity 

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. 

Recruitment Agencies 

CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void. 

Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party. 

Export Control Compliance 

This position requires access to export controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. 

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰£70,000 - £105,000 + Benefits |

We’re looking for several Senior Product Marketing Managers to own Product Marketing for some of Monzo's most important products across Core Banking, Borrowing and Wealth

At Monzo, Product Marketing is a global product-market fit discipline rather than a GTM discipline. We’re embedded in squads with PMs, Designers, and User Researchers, shaping products and propositions by acting as the voice of the market (UK, Ireland, Spain and future markets). We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead campaign & channel strategy, creative direction, and overall go-to-market approach to bring those propositions to customers. Together, we build the right products and drive their growth. If that’s your flavour of product marketing, Monzo is for you.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll own Product Marketing for a product end-to-end: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and helping bring launches to market. There are two levels of seniority available — we will determine together what best fits you during the interview process.

Where you could join: 

- Core is the foundation of Monzo. It's where we build the products millions of people use every day: from Current Accounts and Joint Accounts to Pots, Subscriptions, Savings Challenge, and all the moments that make managing money feel effortless. This is a role for someone who believes the best product experiences come from getting the fundamentals right, and wants to shape products that become part of people's daily lives.

- Borrowing is helping customers access credit simply, transparently, and responsibly. Today that includes growing products like Flex, Loans, Credit Insights, Mortgages, and Overdrafts in the UK, while also taking Monzo's Flex proposition to millions more customers across Europe. This is a role for someone excited by the challenge of growing an established proposition at home while shaping how it succeeds in new markets; understanding local customer needs, refining the proposition, and helping build the foundations for Monzo to win internationally.

- Wealth is building the future of how people grow their money: helping millions of customers save, invest, and plan for retirement with the same simplicity and trust they expect from their current account. It spans Savings, Investments, Pensions, Insurance, and brand new wealth-building experiences. This is a role for someone who wants to challenge how traditional wealth products work and make growing money feel simpler, more accessible, and more rewarding for everyday customers.

Key Responsibilities 

- Own Product Marketing for a Product. You'll define a 2–4 quarter Product Marketing strategy that connects customer needs, market opportunity, and product direction into a clear plan. You'll own Product Marketing across the full product lifecycle from early discovery through launches and iteration. You'll be the go-to person for understanding how your product succeeds in the market.

- Become the expert on your market. You'll build a deep understanding of your customers, competitors, and category, using research, data, and experimentation to identify opportunities that influence product priorities. You'll bring the voice of the market into day-to-day product decisions and help your squad make better bets.

- Define positioning customers understand. You'll create clear, differentiated positioning and messaging that helps customers understand why your product matters. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Writers, and Integrated Marketing to ensure that positioning is reflected consistently across the product experience and everything customers see.

- Influence Product Strategy. You'll work alongside Product Managers, Designers, and Researchers to shape product strategy with customer and market insight. Product teams will seek your perspective before committing to product bets, and you'll help turn customer problems into products people genuinely love.

- Shape successful launches. You'll design launch strategies that fit the customer problem, partner with Integrated Marketing on campaigns, and coordinate cross-functional launches across Product, Marketing, Operations, and Support. You'll measure what worked, learn quickly, and continuously improve how your product reaches customers.

- Measure what matters. You'll use customer and commercial data to understand whether your work is making a difference. You'll build business cases for product decisions, measure launches against meaningful outcomes, and use what you learn to strengthen positioning, propositions, and future product decisions.

This is for you if: 

- You enjoy owning entire products. You're comfortable taking responsibility for Product Marketing across a full product experience, from customer insight through to positioning. 

- You solve ambiguous problems with evidence. You enjoy understanding customers, identifying market opportunities and turning insight into practical product and marketing recommendations.

- You know what makes products win. You combine customer insight, market understanding and commercial thinking to build products and propositions people genuinely love.

- You influence through collaboration. You enjoy working closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, Researchers and Integrated Marketing, bringing people with you through evidence rather than authority.

- You're always improving and helping others improve. You seek feedback, develop your craft and contribute to making the team stronger through sharing knowledge and helping others. Mentor more junior team members informally.

The Interview Process 

Our interview process involves three main stages:

- Initial Call (30mins) 

- Case Study Presentation (45mins)

- x2 final interviews via Google Meet (45mins for each interview)

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! 

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here. 

You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to ----- You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.

What’s in it for you: 

- £70,000 - £105,000 as a base salary

- This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK 

- We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

- Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences 

- And much more, see our full list of benefits here 

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. 

#LI-JB1 #LI-REMOTE

Equal opportunities for everyone 

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog , 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.
