title: Senior Director, Health Economics and Outcomes Research, International
description:
Mavericks Wanted 

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on 
  
In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.  
  
Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work. 

About BridgeBio Pharma, Inc. 

BridgeBio is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to discovering, developing, and delivering transformative medicines for patients living with genetic diseases and genetically defined cancers. Since our founding in 2015, we have built a diverse portfolio of more than 20 drug development programs, ranging from early discovery to late-stage clinical trials, across multiple therapeutic areas including precision oncology, cardiology, endocrinology, neurology, and renal disease. We have already achieved regulatory approval for three therapies and continue to advance promising science from academia into meaningful treatments for patients worldwide. 

Who We Are 

BridgeBio is a global biotechnology company with our Global Headquarters located in San Francisco, USA, and our International HQ located in Zug, Switzerland. Since establishing our European presence in 2021, we’ve been building empowered, high-performing teams across countries — with experienced colleagues who move quickly, take ownership, and are fueling the company’s international growth. 

At BridgeBio, you’ll find an energetic and collaborative culture where pragmatism meets bold decision-making. We embrace uncertainty with confidence, guided by our commitment to making a meaningful impact for patients. Our people are trusted and empowered, united by urgency, purpose, and the drive to advance science for patients around the world. 

To learn more about our story and company culture, visit us at https://bridgebio.com 

What You’ll Do 

You will report to the VP, Head of Market Access, International and work closely with Market Access, Medical Affairs, Commercial International, and Launch Excellence colleagues across BridgeBio’s international markets, to drive strategic initiatives that support BridgeBio’s mission of delivering transformative medicines to patients globally.

Your primary purpose will be to lead the international HEOR strategy, generating and leveraging health economic and outcomes research evidence to secure timely, sustainable patient access to the company’s products. This includes oversight of HTA submissions, value dossiers, and real-world evidence studies across multiple international markets. In this role you ensure alignment of HEOR priorities with clinical value, launch timelines, and market access strategy.

You will also be a core member of the International Market Access team, contributing HEOR and evidence-generation expertise to global decision-making and ensuring alignment across regions while representing diverse market perspectives.

This role requires strong collaboration with cross-functional colleagues and external stakeholders across multiple countries to ensure high-quality execution and impact. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in health economics and outcomes research across several international markets and experience supporting the introduction of innovative therapies in a global biotech environment. You are eager to make a meaningful contribution in pre-launch and launch phases, particularly within rare diseases and orphan conditions, and bring strong communication skills, adaptability, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.

Responsibilities 

- Define and lead the international HEOR strategy, ensuring alignment with market access and launch objectives across BridgeBio's therapeutic areas

- Design and oversee non-interventional studies, including registries and real-world evidence generation, from protocol development through publication

- Lead early payer engagement with key HTA/payer bodies (e.g. NICE UK, G-BA Germany, HAS France) to inform evidence generation strategy and reimbursement dossier development

- Closely collaborate with Market Access, Medical Affairs, and Commercial colleagues to ensure value and access optimization across international launches

- Provide health economic modeling and outcomes research expertise to support pricing and reimbursement strategy

- Manage external vendors, budgets, and contracts for HEOR studies, ensuring rigorous project management across competing deadlines

Where You’ll Work 

This is an office role based in our Zug Office, requiring in-office presence, with approximately 10% travel to support HTA engagements and stakeholder meetings across international markets.

Who You Are 

- Graduate degree in health economics, epidemiology, health services research, or another research-focused public health field (PhD preferred); 9+ years of experience with an MSc/MPH, or 7+ years with a PhD, in HEOR or related fields

- Extensive experience leading HTA submissions and pricing negotiations across multiple international markets, ideally including Europe, particularly in rare diseases and orphan conditions

- Direct experience engaging with HTA organizations such as NICE, CADTH, PBAC, HAS, IQWiG/G-BA, and ICER

- Demonstrated in-depth understanding of health economic modeling, patient-reported outcomes, statistics, and real-world evidence studies, including registries and observational study design, implementation, analysis, and interpretation

- Capable of independently managing complex, multicultural, cross-functional teams and non-interventional study projects on an international basis

- Strong project management abilities, including contracting, budgeting, and vendor management, with the ability to manage competing deadlines and rapidly shifting priorities

- Comfortably influencing senior stakeholders across medical, clinical, and commercial teams, and operating effectively within a matrix organization

- International mobility and willingness to travel internationally, approximately 10% of time

Rewarding Those Who Make the Mission Possible 

We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return.

- Market leading compensation

- Hybrid work model - we value your flexibility in how you work, but encourage time in the office to strengthen our culture, collaboration, and sense of community

- We provide career development through regular feedback, continuous education and professional development programs

- We celebrate strong performance with financial rewards, peer-to-peer recognition, and growth opportunities.

As a global company, our comprehensive benefits may vary based on location. We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return. 

For BridgeBio Full-Time U.S Based Roles: 

Financial & Rewards 

- Market-leading compensation

Health & Well-Being

Skill Development & Career Paths:

title: Werkstudent im Bereich Legal / Compliance (d/m/w)
description:
Ihre Aufgaben Bei NYALA begleitest Du die Weiterentwicklung unseres Angebots von juristischer Seite. Du lernst, regulatorische Anforderungen umzusetzen sowie zu diesen mit den Aufsichtsbehörden zu kommunizieren. Dabei wendest Du den bestehenden Rechtsrahmen aus eWpG, eWpRV, KWG und GwG an, entwickelst unsere Produkte in diesem weiter, begleitest mit uns aktuelle Entwicklungen bei der Gesetzgebung und nimmst über Stellungnahmen und Konsultationen aktiv Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung der Gesetzgebung zur Blockchain-Technologie. Du hast damit nicht nur die Möglichkeit, die geltenden Regelungen auf konkrete Sachverhalte im Unternehmen anzuwenden (und das anders als in der Kanzlei umfassend und gestaltend, nicht nur im Rahmen eines beschränkten Beratungsauftrags), sondern auch zukünftige Entwicklungen aktiv mitzugestalten. 
Im operativen Tagesgeschäft arbeitest du direkt dem Geldwäsche-, Compliance- und Risikobeauftragten zu, bereitest Sachverhalte entscheidungsreif auf und hältst Fristen, Maßnahmen und Wiedervorlagen nach.
Im Schwerpunkt des Berichtswesens erstellst du Vorlagen für die Berichte an Funktionsträger im Unternehmen, pflegst Kennzahlen und Auswertungen, hältst Richtlinien, Handbücher und Arbeitsanweisungen aktuell und unterstützt bei Jahresabschluss- und Sonderprüfungen.

Ihr Profil Du brennst für Technologie und speziell DLT, glaubst an die revolutionäre Chance der Blockchain im Finanzsystem und hast Interesse an kapitalmarktrechtlichen Fragestellungen. Vollständige Vorkenntnisse in eWpG, GwG und KWG erwarten wir nicht; ein großer Teil dieses Rechtsrahmens ist selbst erst wenige Jahre alt und entwickelt sich beständig weiter. Wir erwarten Sorgfalt im Detail, Verbindlichkeit bei Fristen, die Fähigkeit, komplizierte Sachverhalte knapp und nachvollziehbar zu verschriftlichen, und Diskretion im Umgang mit Kunden- und Unternehmensdaten. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch ist für Aufsichtskorrespondenz und im Meldewesen erforderlich, Englisch für Korrespondenz mit internationalen Kunden und für die Interpretation von Rechtstexten von Vorteil.

Warum wir? Compliance ist bei uns nicht nur nachgelagerte Kontrollinstanz, sondern Voraussetzung des Geschäftsmodells: ohne belastbare Registerführung und rechtssichere Verfahrensabläufe gibt es kein Kryptowertpapier. Du arbeitest deshalb nicht an einem Ausschnitt, sondern siehst den vollständigen Zyklus – von der Anbahnung eines Emittenten über die Aufnahme in das Register bis zur Berichterstattung an Geschäftsführung und Aufsicht. 

Die Smart Registry als Institut bietet hervorragende Voraussetzungen, über den Tellerrand zu schauen: Viele unserer Produkte werden durch neue Gesetze erst ermöglicht und erst in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden entwickelt. Wir waren im Februar 2024 der erste Kryptowertpapierregisterführer, welche elektronische Aktien nach dem eWpG eingetragen hat. 

Werde Teil eines motivierten, technikbegeisterten und internationalen Teams mit starker Unternehmenskultur direkt am Ku'damm in Berlin. Wir bieten dir Einarbeitung unmittelbar durch die Beauftragten, direkten Zugang zur Geschäftsführung – und die Perspektive, in Themen eigenverantwortlich hineinzuwachsen. Wer eine große, arbeitsteilige Compliance-Abteilung sucht, ist bei uns falsch; wer früh Verantwortung und einen ungewöhnlich vollständigen Blick auf ein reguliertes Geschäft will, richtig.

title: Cloud Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Ab sofort

Das erwartet dich Wir bauen mit unserem Green-Field-Ansatz eine neue Cloud in unseren deutschen Rechenzentren auf — vollständig selbst gehostet, cloud-native und ohne Abhängigkeit von amerikanischen Hyperscalern. Jeder unserer Kunden erhält ein dediziertes Kubernetes-Cluster auf Basis des SUSE-Stacks (Harvester, RKE2), ausgerollt und verwaltet über Fleet, mit eigenem Tenant-Management.

Du bist nicht Betreiber eines fremden Systems, sondern gestaltest die Plattform, auf der unsere Software als SaaS läuft — mit echter Verantwortung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.

Digitale Souveränität ist bei uns kein Versprechen, sondern Betriebsrealität. Auf dieser Plattform laufen die geschäftskritischen Anwendungen von Versicherern und Auftraggebern der öffentlichen Hand. Die Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Informationssicherheit und Nachweisbarkeit sind auf allerhöchsten Level. Hierfür sind unsere Managed Services nach BSI C5 testiert.

Das erwartet dich 

Plattform entwickeln und gestalten 
- Konzeption, Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung der selbst gehosteten Cloud-Plattform (Multi-Cluster, ohne Hyperscaler-Abhängigkeit, volle Kontrolle)
- Architektur und Design hochverfügbarer Kubernetes-Cluster im SUSE-Stack, inklusive Networking, Storage, Load Balancing und Authentifizierung
- Design und Weiterentwicklung des Tenant-Konzepts: isolierte Kundenumgebungen, Verantwortung für Architektur und Lifecycle
- Abstimmung mit der Entwicklung zu performance- und verfügbarkeitsrelevanten Anforderungen an das Cluster- und Tenant-Konzept
- Weiterentwicklung des Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepts: Ein verteilter In-Memory Ansatz über mehrere Knoten (Schwarmtechnik), der die Echtzeitfähigkeit der Anwendungen im Normalbetrieb sicherstellt
Automatisieren und standardisieren 
- GitOps-Workflows über ArgoCD und Fleet — von der Erstauslieferung bis zum Day-2-Betrieb vollständig automatisiert
- Infrastructure as Code mit Ansible, Terraform oder vergleichbaren Tools; Policy as Code für Sicherheit und Governance
- CI/CD-Integration und Standardisierung der Deployment-Prozesse
Brücke zu den Entwicklungsteams und Kunden 
- Platform Engineering für interne Teams: Aufbau von Self-Service-Fähigkeiten, Definition von Standards, Begleitung des Onboardings
- Aktive Unterstützung der Entwicklungsteams bei der Migration ihrer Workloads in die Cloud-Plattform
- Verarbeitung von Erkenntnissen aus dem laufenden Betrieb (Monitoring-Daten, Incidents) zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von Stabilität, Sicherheit und Performance

Das bringst du mit Must-have 
- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Cloud- oder Platform-Engineering, in Container-Technologien oder Infrastrukturautomatisierung
- Fundierte Kubernetes Kenntnisse, idealerweise aus dem Betrieb produktiver Multi-Cluster-Umgebungen
- Erfahrung mit GitOps-Workflows (idealerweise ArgoCD oder Fleet) und Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Ansible, Terraform)
- Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine und Termine an unseren weiteren Standorten
Nice-to-have

Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben - Du entwickelst Fullstack in TypeScript , vom Kundenportal über das Verwaltercockpit bis zu den Services und der Infrastruktur dahinter, auf der grünen Wiese und ohne Altlasten. - Unser Stack : TypeScript durchgehend, mit React und Next.js im Frontend und Node im Backend, als Monorepo auf Google Cloud (Infrastructure as Code), dazu Postgres und event-getriebene Prozesse. Du musst nicht alles davon kennen, den Rest lernst du bei uns.

Was du mitbringen solltest - 2 bis 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der Webentwicklung.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Supply Chain Management Technology (all genders)
description:
About the role: What's in the Box

As a Staff Engineer in our Supply Chain Management organization, you will be responsible for defining, securing, and implementing technical solutions for business problems. You will play a critical role as our systems scale to handle a jump from 1.2 million to over 2.4 million produced boxes per week due to recent software product consolidation. You will look after speeding up development, decision-making, and problem-solving. You will work with our neighboring teams to ensure that our efforts aim to achieve a clearer architecture and boundaries between tech teams to support autonomy. You will communicate directly with our business stakeholders and multiple tech teams supporting local markets. You will report to the Director of Engineering in the Production tribe. This role does not include people management responsibilities.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

- Assume technical leadership within a tribe and own the most challenging tech decisions, including architecture, design, development, deployment, and operational excellence.

- Support the teams in the architectural design and help to maintain architectural integrity in the scope of the tribe and beyond.

- Spend a significant portion of your time orchestrating code generation—guiding AI coding agents, rigorously reviewing their implementations, and refining logic based on organization needs.

- Solve software problems that have visible risks, roadblocks, and constraints. You will navigate an environment that is approximately 70% greenfield development and 30% legacy systems , managing dependencies, data quality, compliance, and architectural transformations.

- Mentor more junior engineers by fostering a culture of continuous learning and growth.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients 

- Ideally, 10+ years of engineering experience, including 2+ years in a staff/principal level capacity and technical leadership.

- Strong capability in working with different stakeholders and experience addressing physical world problems with software solutions.

- Full-Stack & Agentic Engineering: Deep problem-solving skills and full-stack proficiency (e.g., C#, Python, Golang, and modern frontend technologies). You bring hands-on experience leveraging AI coding agents (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code) in production, moving beyond basic prompting to master context engineering, workflow decomposition, and the implementation of strict guardrails for reliable agent outputs.

- Experience with data engineering fundamentals is highly desirable, including expertise in data modeling, governance, quality assurance, and proficiency in data processing and storage systems.

- Expertise in designing and implementing modular systems, including proficiency in synchronous/asynchronous communication.

- A team player attitude and a passion for helping others grow through peer-to-peer mentoring, knowledge-sharing sessions, and advocating for best engineering practices, such as CI/CD, TDD, BDD, DDD, and Design Patterns.

- An agile mindset with the ability to advocate for cross-functional collaboration.

Interacting with front-end developers, designers, product managers and our teams around the world is very much part of our day-to-day, so communication skills are vital. We are looking for strong problem-solvers who can apply their engineering skills to a wide range of platforms and environments, while also acting as an ambassador to coach team members and stakeholders.

What we offer: The Toppings 

- You’ll receive a competitive salary package, including a HelloFresh-subsidized pension scheme.

- Enjoy savings on your weekly HelloFresh box.

- Support your mental wellbeing with access to platforms like Headspace and Spill.

- Stay active with a discounted Urban Sports Club membership and other wellbeing resources.

- Balance your life with our flexible hybrid model.

- Recharge with sabbatical leave options in addition to standard time off.

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

Als Stagiair(e) Influencer & Performance Marketing ondersteun je ons team bij zowel het opbouwen van sterke influencer-relaties als het optimaliseren van onze paid social-campagnes. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid en de ruimte om direct bij te dragen aan ons succes in Nederland. 

Wat ga je doen? 

Influencer Marketing 

• Strategische opbouw & schaling: Je ondersteunt bij het opbouwen, schalen en optimaliseren van onze influencer-samenwerkingen binnen de Nederlandse markt.
• Creatieve concepten: Je denkt actief mee over de ontwikkeling van creatieve, authentieke en converterende concepten voor onze campagnes.
• End-to-end relatiebeheer: Je zoekt geschikte samenwerkingspartners en begeleidt het volledige proces – van het eerste contact, de onderhandelingen en contractafhandeling tot briefings en relatiebeheer.
• Logistiek & Communicatie: Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor Nederlandse influencers, stelt briefings op en draagt de zorg voor een vlekkeloze product- en pakketverzending.
• Scouting & Nieuwe kanalen: Je bent op zoek naar opvallend talent en verkent nieuwe kanalen (zoals YouTube, TikTok en podcasts) om ons netwerk uit te breiden.
• Performance & Reporting: Je ondersteunt bij het monitoren, documenteren en analyseren van campagneresultaten om toekomstige samenwerkingen aan te scherpen. 

Performance Marketing 

• Paid Social campagnes: Je helpt het team bij het beheren, optimaliseren en schalen van onze paid social media-kanalen, met een sterke focus op de META-platformen (Facebook & Instagram).
• Contentcreatie: Je ondersteunt het volledige creatieve proces voor META-ads – van de eerste brainstorm en videoproductie tot de uiteindelijke publicatie.
• Lokalisatie & Vertaling: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het vertalen en aanpassen van internationale advertenties en copy naar pakkende, Nederlandstalige ad-creatives.
• On-camera aanwezigheid (Pre): Je vindt het leuk en bent comfortabel om zelf voor de camera te staan voor het maken van authentieke (UGC-style) video-content voor de Nederlandse markt. 

THIS IS YOU 

Als jij je met passie inzet voor duurzaamheid en supergemotiveerd bent om samen met ons de wereld een stukje schoner te maken, dan vinden wij dat echt geweldig!
Als je daarnaast graag proactief én in teamverband werkt, en je elke kleine en grote uitdaging ziet als een kans om nog beter te worden – dan zijn we nu al een heel klein beetje verliefd op je.
Als je tot slot ook nog beschikt over de volgende vaardigheden en ervaring, dan weten we het bijna zeker: dit zou het begin kunnen zijn van een heel mooi liefdesverhaal!

• Je bent woonachtig in de regio München en bent bereid om op ons kantoor te werken.
• Je volgt momenteel een Bachelor- of Masteropleiding in de richting van marketing, media- & communicatiewetenschappen, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare studierichting.
• Je bent voor een periode van minimaal 6 maanden beschikbaar.
• Je hebt een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal (vloeiend/moedertaal) en goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels.
• Je werkt zelfstandig, gestructureerd en nauwkeurig, maar bent bovenal een enthousiaste teamplayer.
• Je hebt affiniteit met data, volgt trends op social media op de voet en begrijpt wat een video of ad 'hoofden doet draaien'.
• Pluspunt: Je staat graag voor de camera en vindt het leuk om zelf video's (Reels/TikToks) op te nemen! 

THIS IS EVERDROP 

Onze missie 💚🌱🌎 

We willen de wereld veranderen – samen met jou! De alledaagse producten van everdrop helpen mensen om op een eenvoudige manier hun ecologische voetafdruk in het huishouden te verkleinen. In 2020 zijn we gestart met onze schoonmaaktabs. Sindsdien hebben onze huishoud- en verzorgingsproducten al meer dan 20 miljoen wegwerpplastic flessen en duizenden tonnen aan onnodige CO₂-uitstoot en chemische grondstoffen bespaard.
Sinds 2023 zijn we bovendien een gecertificeerde B Corp. En met jouw hulp willen we everdrop naar een volgend niveau tillen. Sluit je aan bij onze missie en help ons om een duurzame levensstijl zo eenvoudig te maken dat deze de nieuwe standaard in onze samenleving wordt. 

Onze Benefits 🍲💪🏡 

- Afwisselend, betekenisvol en doelgericht werk 

- Een geweldige teamspirit en regelmatige teamevents 

- Een prachtig, licht en ruim kantoor vlak bij de Isar 

- Een outdoor sportmogelijkheid direct naast ons kantoor 

- Een maandelijkse voucher voor everdrop-producten in onze medewerkerswinkel 

- Family & Friends -kortingscodes voor everdrop en onze zusterbedrijven binnen Startups for Tomorrow 

- Een membership bij FutureBens & toegang tot corporate benefits 

- Flexibele werktijden 

- Twee betaalde verlofdagen per jaar voor je eigen persoonlijke milieu- of gemeenschapsprojecten ( Green & Social Impact Days ) 

- Je eigen MacBook zolang je bij everdrop werkt 

Onze waarden 💛🏳️‍🌈🤝‍ 

Bij everdrop streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse cultuur waarin iedereen gelijke kansen krijgt. De ambitie om de wereld een stukje beter te maken, vormt een vast onderdeel van hoe we iedere dag werken. Bovenal willen we het bewustzijn voor onze planeet én voor elkaar vergroten. 

Een voorbeeld van hoe we dit bewustzijn op de werkvloer stimuleren, zijn onze Power Days . Menstruerende collega's die last hebben van menstruatiepijn kunnen één of meerdere extra betaalde vrije dagen opnemen – zonder vragen of verantwoording af te hoeven leggen.
Daarnaast zijn onze Green & Social Impact Days twee extra betaalde verlofdagen per jaar die je kunt inzetten voor je eigen milieu- of gemeenschapsprojecten. 

Ook in ons sollicitatieproces proberen we zo bewust en inclusief mogelijk te werk te gaan.
We behandelen iedereen gelijk, ongeacht afkomst, gender, religie, leeftijd, uiterlijk, taal, cultuur, nationaliteit, burgerlijke staat, seksuele geaardheid of lichamelijke beperking. 

We zijn zeker niet perfect – maar we willen iedere dag beter worden en bij elke stap iets nieuws leren. Want dat is waar iedere reis om draait.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer (Software) (all genders)
description:
Your mission As our Quality Assurance Engineer (Software) , you will help ensure the quality, reliability and usability of ProGlove’s connected solutions across embedded and IoT devices, mobile applications, front-end experiences and back-end services.

You will take ownership of quality assurance within the team, combining thoughtful manual testing with effective automation. By challenging assumptions, investigating complex system behavior and continuously improving how we test, you will help us deliver dependable products to our customers.

In this role, you will:

- Take ownership of QA processes within the team and champion quality throughout the product development lifecycle.
- Analyze end-to-end system architectures, user flows and integrations to identify risks and gaps in test coverage.
- Create clear and concise test plans based on product and technical requirements and document them in TestRail.
- Plan and execute functional, regression, API, integration and cross-platform testing.
- Contribute to our automation frameworks by designing and implementing new automated tests and maintaining existing test suites.
- Perform hands-on manual and exploratory testing where it adds value.
- Configure and maintain dedicated test environments and test data and support performance and load testing when required.
- Share findings transparently, raise risks early and collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to resolve issues.
- Continuously improve our testing approaches, tools and ways of working.

Your profile At ProGlove, technical expertise matter, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and applies pragmatic judgment.

- You bring 4+ years of relevant quality assurance experience, including at least 2 years of hands-on test automation experience.
- You have experience building or contributing to automation frameworks and maintaining automated test suites.
- You understand and can apply the full Software Testing Life Cycle, including functional, regression, API, integration and cross-platform testing.
- You can analyze end-to-end architectures, user flows and integrations, identify quality risks and translate them into appropriate test coverage.
- You have hands-on experience with automation tools and frameworks such as Pytest, Cypress, Selenium, Appium or REST Assured.
- You are comfortable configuring and maintaining test environments and test data.
- You have experience executing performance or load tests.
- You take end-to-end ownership, communicate clearly and raise risks early.
- You enjoy investigating complex issues, challenging assumptions and balancing thoroughness with pragmatism.
- You collaborate openly with engineers and other stakeholders.
- You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment.
Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable, but is not required:

- Python or JavaScript and Git
- UNIX or Linux environments
- Agile product development environments
- Test documentation tools, especially TestRail
- AWS or other cloud platforms
- Testing embedded systems, IoT devices, mobile applications or connected hardware ecosystems

Why us? - Diversity and inclusion: Diversity is core to us and one of the reasons for our success.
- Career development: We support active and individual career planning and progression at your own pace.
- Cutting-edge technology: Choose the devices that work best for you from our range of supported IT products.
- Location-specific benefits: Benefit from offerings tailored to your location, such as gym membership, pension funding and mobility support.
- ProHealth: Our global health program supports the physical and mental well-being of all team members.
- Employee referral rewards: Earn €2,000 before tax by referring someone who joins our team.
- Office events: In addition to our summer and winter parties, smaller office events are part of everyday life at ProGlove.

What success looks like - Quality risks are identified early, communicated clearly and addressed before they affect customers.
- Critical user flows and integrations have reliable, risk-based test coverage across the relevant platforms and system components.
- Automated test coverage grows in a maintainable way and supports faster, more confident releases.
- Test plans, results and quality documentation are clear, current and useful to the relevant stakeholders.
- QA is an active part of product development, with shared ownership of quality across the team.
- Testing processes, environments and tools become more effective and scalable over time.

Meet your team You will join our Quality Assurance team and work closely with software, embedded and mobile engineers, as well as other relevant stakeholders across Product and Engineering.

The team values hands-on collaboration, clear communication and shared ownership of product quality. You will contribute your perspective early in the development process, help the team understand quality risks and work together with colleagues to turn requirements and user flows into practical, maintainable test coverage.

title: Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem
description:
Your mission As our Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem , you will define the product what and why for how ProGlove devices connect, integrate and create value within the enterprise Android ecosystem.

ProGlove is evolving from a wearable scanner company into a Worker Companion company, bringing together ergonomic wearable hardware, software, connectivity, workflow guidance, data and intelligence. With the MAI Wearable Companion, we are entering a broader ecosystem of enterprise applications, technologies, standards, partners and customer infrastructure.

Your mission will be to make our products easy to adopt, integrate and deploy at scale – without turning every customer opportunity into a bespoke engineering project. You will identify recurring customer needs, translate them into scalable capabilities and propositions, and decide where ProGlove should own, enable or partner. In doing so, you will help turn integration from a technical necessity into a source of differentiation, customer value and commercial opportunity.

You will work closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion device. While they own the device proposition, you will own how the device connects to and creates value in the wider ecosystem. Together, you will shape a coherent end-to-end proposition for customers, developers, integrators and partners.

Your day-to-day 
- Define and evolve the product strategy and priorities for ProGlove’s enterprise Android integration and ecosystem capabilities, aligned with customer needs and business goals.
- Work directly with customers, Sales and Solution Architecture to identify recurring problems, distinguish individual requests from broader market needs and turn the right opportunities into scalable solutions.
- Translate recurring integration needs into repeatable product capabilities such as APIs, SDKs, tools, interfaces, documentation, integration patterns and deployment solutions.
- Shape the product experience around device setup, provisioning, application distribution, device management and other capabilities required to deploy and operate connected device fleets at scale.
- Make clear, pragmatic decisions about where ProGlove should own, enable or partner , balancing customer value, strategic control, speed, scalability and technical complexity.
- Identify the platforms, applications, standards and ecosystem players that matter to our customers, and shape the integrations, certifications and technology partnerships that strengthen our proposition.
- Explore where integration capabilities, software, services and ecosystem propositions can create differentiated value and support commercial or recurring-revenue opportunities.
- Partner closely with Engineering and the Product Manager for the Wearable Companion to create alignment on customer problems, priorities, trade-offs and desired outcomes.
- Enable Sales and other customer-facing teams to clearly explain our Android proposition, supported capabilities, integrations and common deployment patterns.
- Maintain a forward-looking view of enterprise Android, AOSP, enterprise mobility, AI and adjacent technologies, and translate relevant developments into strategic options and product priorities.

Your profile At ProGlove, technical expertise matters, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and turns complexity into clear, pragmatic decisions.

- You bring strong Product Management experience in B2B or enterprise technology and can define strategy, discover meaningful customer problems, prioritize opportunities and turn them into scalable products or propositions.
- You are commercially minded and naturally connect product decisions with customer value, differentiation, business impact and opportunities to capture value.
- You are comfortable working with enterprise software, platforms, connected devices, integrations or technology ecosystems, and understand the realities of complex customer IT environments.
- You have enough technical depth to understand architecture, interfaces and trade-offs, contribute credibly to platform and integration discussions, and recognize when deeper engineering expertise is needed.
- You think in systems and patterns: when faced with a customer requirement, you look beyond the immediate request to understand why it exists, how broadly it applies and what a simple, repeatable solution could look like.
- You take end-to-end ownership, move topics forward without waiting for perfect instructions and remain effective when the product space or path ahead is not yet fully defined.
- You collaborate generously and build trust across Product, Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture, customers and external partners. You can create alignment and drive decisions without relying on formal authority.
- You communicate clearly and transparently, raise risks early and can make complex technical and commercial topics understandable to different audiences.
- You are curious about customers, the business and emerging technologies, and continuously test assumptions rather than pursuing technology for its own sake.
- You use pragmatic judgment to balance speed, simplicity, quality and long-term value.
- You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment.
Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable, but is not required:

- Enterprise Android, AOSP or adjacent Android ecosystems, including environments operating outside standard Google Mobile Services.
- Enterprise mobility management, MDM/EMM, device provisioning, application deployment or connected fleet management.
- Rugged or industrial devices, IoT or edge devices, connected hardware or other B2B technology ecosystems.
- APIs, SDKs, developer or integrator experiences and enterprise integrations.
- Platform or ecosystem strategy, technology partnerships, certification programs or developer and partner ecosystems.
- Enterprise customers deploying technology at scale.
Direct Android Product Management experience is an advantage, but not essential if you bring strong Product Management expertise and relevant experience from an adjacent enterprise technology ecosystem.

Why us? This is an opportunity to shape an important part of a category that is still being defined. 
Android gives ProGlove access to a much broader technology ecosystem, but the opportunity goes far beyond compatibility. You will help determine what role ProGlove should play in that ecosystem, which capabilities we should own, where we should partner, what customers and developers should be able to build around us, and where integration itself can become a source of differentiation and recurring business value. 
ProGlove already has the customer base, market credibility, technology and industrial expertise to build on. Our products are used in some of the world's most demanding operational environments. What we are now building is the next layer. 
Over time, success will mean more than making our own products easier to integrate. It will mean creating capabilities, interfaces and ecosystem relationships that customers, application providers and partners actively choose to build around - moving ProGlove from ecosystem participant toward ecosystem shaper. 
If you are excited by the idea of turning complex technology ecosystems into simple, valuable products - and helping shape how the next generation of frontline technology connects with the digital world - we would love to meet you. 
Join us in building the future of frontline work.

What success looks like - ProGlove has a clear, customer-backed strategy and prioritized roadmap for Android integration and ecosystem capabilities.
- Recurring customer and integration needs are turned into scalable, repeatable solutions rather than one-off engineering projects.
- Customers can adopt, integrate, deploy and manage ProGlove devices more easily within their existing enterprise environments.
- Decisions about what ProGlove should own, enable or partner are made transparently and based on customer value, business impact and long-term scalability.
- Product, Engineering, Sales and Solution Architecture are aligned on priorities, supported capabilities and key trade-offs.
- Customer-facing teams can confidently communicate our Android proposition and common deployment patterns without relying on Product or Engineering in every opportunity.
- Relevant integrations, partnerships and commercial opportunities are identified, validated and translated into tangible product or business outcomes.

Meet your team You will join our Product team and report directly to the CPO. You will work especially closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion, as well as colleagues across Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture and Product Marketing.

This is a highly cross-functional role. You will bring together customer needs, technical realities and commercial opportunities, while also building relationships with external technology partners, platform providers and integrators. The team values open collaboration, clear communication and shared ownership of outcomes.

title: Product Manager - EXOtube

Exolaunch is a global leader in launch mission management, satellite integration and satellite deployment technologies. The company fulfills launch contracts for industry leaders, the world's most innovative startups, research institutions, government organizations, and international space agencies.

Rideshare structures are the answer to a growing diversification of launch opportunities coupled with a market seeking flexible and agile access to space for a growing number of satellite constellations. The EXOtube Product Manager is a multi-faceted role which combines technical management of complex development and launch planning projects with customer and market facing Business Development and Sales work. You will be coordinating the development and qualification of EXOtube projects , becoming intimately familiar with how our products function and how we execute our missions. The ideal candidate for this role has a background in space technology, structural design and environmental testing for space, is an excellent communicator and team player, and is passionate about being part of a dynamic team that is driving the satellite industry forward. 

Your mission - Manage the requirements, design, qualification and launch planning of EXOtube projects . 

- Lead communication with customers and ensure a fluent progression of the project. 

- Help develop concepts for Ground Support Equipment and test hardware and coordinate with suppliers.

- Solidify and expand upon Exolaunch’s commitment to customer care and service excellence .

- Attend space conferences and industry events – represent Exolaunch at the highest professional level 

- Gather customer requirements and work with the engineering teams to iterate on and improve Exolaunch product offerings and cultivate new business opportunities. 

Your profile - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in structural, mechanical or space engineering or a similar field.

- Excellent written and spoken English. 

- Excellent technical communication skills.

title: Growth Manager Revenue Operations (m/w/d)
description:
1KOMMA5°

Bei 1KOMMA5° verfolgen wir eine Vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free . Dafür bauen wir mit Heartbeat AI das Energiesystem der Zukunft. Bist du dabei?

Wir bringen regionales Handwerk und skalierbare Software zusammen: Solar, Speicher, Wärmepumpe und E-Mobilität denken wir nicht einzeln, sondern steuern sie als intelligentes, integriertes Gesamtsystem in unserem virtuellen Kraftwerk. Direkt verbunden mit dem Strommarkt – in Echtzeit, vollautomatisiert. So wird Energie dann genutzt, wenn sie erneuerbar verfügbar und besonders günstig ist. Bis 2030 wollen wir 1,5 Millionen Haushalte auf erneuerbare Energien umstellen. Über 3.000 Menschen arbeiten jeden Tag daran, an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit, von Finnland bis Australien.

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen. 

Deine Position

- Jeden Monat fragen Tausende Haushalte bei uns eine Beratung für Solar, Wärmepumpe oder Heartbeat AI an. Bis zur Unterschrift ist es ein ganz schöner Weg: Inside Sales, über 40 Standorte, Kalender, CRM und jede Menge Übergaben per Hand. Mal läuft die Pipeline richtig gut, mal hakt es an mehreren Stellen gleichzeitig

- Da setzt du an. Du machst diesen Weg schneller, sauberer und messbar, und du baust dafür selbst: Systeme, Prozesse und Auswertungen, die auch dann noch halten, wenn wir weiter wachsen

- Du wirst Teil unseres kleinen RevOps-Teams in Growth. Wir sind so etwas wie das Schweizer Taschenmesser im Haus: Mal löschen wir Brände, mal bauen wir Dinge, die dauerhaft laufen. Wir sind über die ganze Customer Journey unterwegs und sitzen mit Sales, Marketing und Tech am Tisch, und die wollen nicht immer dasselbe. Wir halten es pragmatisch. Uns interessiert vor allem, ob es fürs Business und für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden wirklich was bringt

Was du verantwortest

- Mehrere Journey Funnel-Stufen und die wichtigsten Kennzahlen liegen bei dir. Du behältst die Hebel im Blick, findest heraus, wo und warum es hakt, baust die Lösung und testest sie an ein, zwei Standorten. Du skalierst funktionierende Lösungen in alle Märkte

- Je nach Profil arbeitest du mehr in der Breite oder mehr in der Tiefe. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt entweder auf Lead Routing, Scoring, Qualifizierung und unserem Kontakt- und Terminsystem oder auf dem Weg vom qualifizierten Lead zum Angebot.

- Dazu gehören die Systeme dahinter: die Dashboards, mit denen gesteuert wird, die Prozesse und Automatisierungen, die alles am Laufen halten, und die Daten, auf denen es aufbaut

- Deine Lösungen baust du selbst, bringst sie in den operativen Betrieb und rollst sie aus. Wo es nötig ist, arbeitest du dabei mit unseren Tech-Teams zusammen

Was du konkret machst

- Steuerung aufbauen: Looker-Dashboards, Alerts und SLAs, mit denen Vertriebsleitungen in der Zentrale und an den Standorten jede Woche arbeiten

- Übergaben automatisieren: Routing, Terminvergabe, die Übergabe von Inside Sales an die Standorte und den Umgang mit No-Shows und Dubletten

- AI-Workflows selbst bauen: Prototypen in Windmill oder n8n, die du gemeinsam mit MarTech und Tech live bringst

- Für saubere Daten sorgen: Felddefinitionen, Pflichtfelder, regelmäßige Datenpflege und Source-of-Truth-Regeln in unserem CRM (Zoho)

- Piloten sauber aufsetzen: Hypothese, ein bis zwei Standorte, gemessenes Ergebnis und am Ende die Entscheidung, ob ausgerollt wird

- Einen Backlog an Optimierungsmaßnahmen aufbauen: Call-Transkripte, Pipeline- und Standortdaten werden zu einer priorisierten Liste, was als Nächstes gebaut wird

- Teams mitnehmen und enablen: Mit Dokumentation, Trainings und Rollouts sorgst du dafür, dass Standortleitungen, Inside Sales und Vertrieb deine Systeme auch nutzen

Damit arbeitest du unter anderem: Zoho CRM, Looker, Windmill, n8n, Heyflow, Calendly, Aircall, ActiveCampaign, Telli, Google Workspace

Dein Profil

- Du hast 1-2+ Jahre oder mehr Erfahrung in RevOps, Sales Ops, GTM Engineering oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle. Dort hast du eine Funnel-Kennzahl wirklich verantwortet und nicht nur reported

- Du weißt, wie ein Sales Funnel funktioniert, von Lead über Qualifizierung, Deal und Angebot bis zum Upsell. Und du weißt, was an jeder Stelle die Conversion und Cycle Time treibt

- Du hast KPIs, Automatisierungen oder AI-Workflows selbst aufgebaut und live gebracht, etwa mit Windmill, n8n, Make, Python, Claude etc. Und sie werden im Alltag tatsächlich skaliert genutzt

- Deine Dashboards baust du selbst, in Looker, Power BI, Tableau oder einem ähnlichen Tool. Dass die Daten am Anfang unsauber sind, schreckt dich nicht ab

- Du kennst dich mit CRM-Systemen aus (Zoho oder ähnliche), vom Datenmodell über Workflows bis zu Integrationen

- Du arbeitest gern eng mit Tech, Sales und Marketing zusammen und sprichst die Sprache aller drei. Technische Trade-offs übersetzt du in Business-Entscheidungen und kommerzielle Prioritäten in technische Anforderungen, ohne dass jemand vermitteln muss

- Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch, in Wort und Schrift

Das ist ein Plus

- Du hast schon mit einer Vertriebsorganisation mit Standorten oder Außendienst gearbeitet, nicht nur aus der Zentrale heraus

- Du hast Lead Management schon praktisch umgesetzt: Scoring, Routing, Nurturing, Terminvergabe etc

- Du hast erste Agents, z.B. extern Voice AI oder Conversational Agents oder interne Effizienz-Automatisierungen schon live gebracht

- Du hast Erfahrung mit dem B2C-Geschäft und mit hochpreisigen Produkten, etwa Energie, Solar, Hausmodernisierung oder Automotive

Benefits

- Du hast die Möglichkeit in unseren brandneuen Büros in der Hamburger Innenstadt & Berlin zu arbeiten und hybrid 

- Nutze dein technisches Equipment auch abseits der Arbeit in deiner Freizeit 

- Du bist Teil eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens mit viel Entwicklungspotenzi al , wo du eigenständig etwas aufbauen kannst und deinen Impact spürst

- Bewege dich in flachen Hierarchien , übernimm schon während deiner Einarbeitung Verantwortung und arbeite direkt mit Teilen des Managements zusammen

- Mit deiner Arbeit unterstützt du den Megatrend “Energie- und Mobilitätswende” und leistest einen konkreten Beitrag zum nachhaltigen Umbau unserer Energie-Infrastruktur

- Sei aktiv und nutze das Angebot von über 7.600 Sportpartnern mit dem EGYM-Wellpass 

- Ob Citybike oder E-Bike – mit unserem Jobrad-Leasing bleibst du flexibel und bist umweltfreundlich unterwegs

- Profitiere von Benefits & Rabatten durch Futurebens

title: 3D & Motion Designer | Robotics
description:
Your tasks

- Get CAD ready for rendering: Turn heavy mechanical assemblies from engineering into clean 3D assets that render, animate and run in real time without falling apart. The hardware stands in our workshop, and the next machine is never far behind.

- Show what is inside: Exploded views, cutaways and assembly animations that explain the mechanics without a technical drawing, so customers understand the tech behind the product.

- Materials that look real: Build shaders for aluminum, stainless steel, glass, rubber, carbon, plastics, displays and LEDs, so a render reads as the actual object rather than as a render. Scenes, materials and rigs stay organized, so the next project does not start from zero.

- Motion design in a house style: Titles, typography, transitions, logo animation, and 2D animation for interface elements like animated displays and icons. It should look like us, not like a template pack.

- Editing and post: Footage from the workshop and tests, mixed with 3D work, becomes what we use on the website, on social, at trade shows and in investor meetings. Editing, grading, sound, subtitles, and a version that fits each channel.

- Put AI to work: You use AI and generative tools (e.g. comfy) where they actually save time, whether that is concepting, cleanup or upscaling. You keep testing what is new, keep what earns a place in the pipeline, and drop the rest.

Your profile

- Background: A degree in motion design, animation or media design, or a self taught route with a reel that makes the question pointless.

- Experience: At least two years of hands on work, whether from an internship, freelance jobs, a studio or your own projects. What the work looks like matters more to us than where it was made.

- CAD is not new to you: You have opened engineering data before and know roughly what happens when a heavy assembly meets a render engine.

- Reel: Hard surfaces, metal, glass and light. Even one personal project done properly tells us more than ten client jobs you only assisted on.

- Tools: Experience in Blender and Cinema 4D, Octane is a plus. After Effects and either Premiere for the cut.

- How you work: Hands on and fast to a first version. You get things finished instead of perfect, and you notice when a detail stops being worth the hours.

- Languages: Fluent English. Good German is a real plus.

Why us?

- Your work is what people see of us : Almost everything the outside world sees of our robots comes out of your hands, and you decide how that looks.

- Everything under one roof: Labs, workshop and test rigs are in the same Kreuzberg building. The engineer you need is a walk away, not a ticket.

- Room to get better: Paid learning time and a personal budget for it, projects where something is allowed to not work the first time, and support for portfolio work and conference talks as the company becomes known.

- Benefits: A benefits package you put together yourself, covering mobility, home setup, health or food. Plus one extra paid day off a year for volunteering or a project you care about.

Send us a link to your work. Best case it includes something you took from CAD data to a finished render, with a note on how. Skip the cover letter. 

Process: Intro call -> Portfolio deep-dive -> Half-day on-site visit with a small design exercise -> Offer.

We build robots for everyone, so we want a team that reflects that. We hire on what you can do, and we welcome applications from people who are underrepresented in 3D and motion. If you don't tick every box but think this is your job, apply anyway.

title: Lakebase Sales Specialist, Associate Director (Germany)
description:
SLSQ327R341

Databricks is seeking multiple Lakebase Sales Specialists (Central) to help customers modernize their operational data foundation with Databricks Lakebase , our fully-managed Postgres offering for intelligent applications . This high-impact role sits within the Lakebase Go-To-Market team and partners closely with regional Account Executives to drive adoption of Lakebase with platform, application, and data teams.

Lakebase gives customers a unified, governed foundation for operational workloads and AI-native applications , helping them move away from a fragmented estate of point databases toward a modern, scalable, serverless Postgres service. If you want to be at the forefront of operational databases for AI and intelligent applications at one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world, this is your opportunity.

This role is based in Munich, Germany (flexible within Germany for the right candidate), and will cover customers in the Central region (Germany, Switzerland, Austria, Eastern Europe).

The impact you will have 

- Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and driving Lakebase activations and consumption within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team.

- Lead with outcomes for key Lakebase personas — including platform teams and developers , data teams , and central IT — articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency.

- Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications , positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences.

- Run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles from discovery and value hypothesis through commercial negotiation and close, navigating executive, technical, and line-of-business stakeholders.

- Orchestrate proof-of-value and POCs that validate Lakebase’s benefits for OLTP-style workloads, reverse ETL, and AI/ML-driven applications, in partnership with solution architects and specialists.

- Compete and win against legacy and cloud-native operational databases by leveraging our compete assets, benchmarks, and customer references.

- Align to measurable business outcomes such as performance, developer productivity, time-to-market for new features, cost reduction, and simplification of the operational data landscape.

- Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to shape territory plans, launch plays, and co-selling motions with key ISVs and GSIs.

- Enable the field by sharing Lakebase best practices, success stories, and sales motions with broader sales teams, helping scale Lakebase proficiency across the organization.

What success looks like in this role 

This role requires the ability to operate across two key motions simultaneously:

- Establish top strategic focus accounts by engaging application development teams to create net-new intelligent applications leveraging Lakebase.

- Drive longer-term Postgres standardization and migration within Databricks' most strategic accounts.

Candidates should demonstrate how they can act as a force multiplier across multiple dimensions of the business.

Success in this role requires strength in four areas:

- Business ownership – Operate at a business-unit level by tracking revenue, pipeline, and key observations, and by identifying areas needing additional focus or support.

- Strategic account engagement – Partner with account teams to engage priority accounts across the global DB700, driving strategic opportunities from initial engagement through successful outcomes.

- Field, account, & customer enablement: Align customers and the field on the value of Lakebase by equipping AEs and SAs with the messaging and execution motions needed to confidently own accounts without specialist intervention.

- Market voice and thought leadership – Develop an internal and external presence by contributing to global AMAs and internal forums, and by representing Databricks at key first- and third-party events.

The interview process is designed to evaluate candidates across all four of these dimensions.

What we look for 

- 7+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience , consistently exceeding quota in complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

- Proven success selling data platforms, operational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, cloud-native DBaaS), or adjacent data/AI infrastructure to technical buyers and business leaders.

- Strong understanding of modern data and application architectures , including cloud-native services, microservices, event-driven systems, and how operational data underpins AI and analytics strategies.

- Ability to sell to both technical stakeholders (developers, architects, data engineers) and business stakeholders (product leaders, operations, line-of-business owners).

- Demonstrated experience leading specialist or overlay motions , working jointly with core Account Executives to create and progress opportunities.

- Executive presence with the ability to whiteboard architectures , lead C-level conversations, and build trust with senior decision makers.

- Strong value selling skills: adept at discovering pain, building a business case, and tying technical capabilities to clear, quantified outcomes.

- Excellent communication, storytelling, and negotiation skills, with comfort presenting to both large and small audiences.

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications 

- Experience selling Postgres, operational databases, OLTP workloads, or transactional cloud database services , ideally within large or strategic accounts.

- Familiarity with data platforms, lakehouse architectures, and cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP), including how operational databases fit within broader data and AI strategies.

- Understanding of reverse ETL, real-time decisioning, and operational analytics use cases, and how they drive value for customer-facing and internal applications.

- Exposure to AI-native and agent-driven applications that depend on low-latency, highly scalable operational data services.

- Prior experience in a high-growth, category-creating environment , helping shape new plays, messaging, and customer narratives.

- Experience collaborating with partners and ISVs to drive joint pipeline and co-sell motions.

This description is intended to outline the core responsibilities and qualifications for the Lakebase Sales Specialist role. Actual responsibilities may evolve as the Lakebase product and go-to-market motions continue to grow and mature. 

About Databricks 

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram .

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here .

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

title: Mid Market Account Executive - DACH
description:
Who we are 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers. 

While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from € 10k to € 300k , selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in Germany or London, UK, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world : Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

- You are a life-long learner : Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.

- You build genuine relationships with your customers : The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.

- You want to be with the best : Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

- 

- Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.

- Get In Early: The DACH Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now. 

- Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.

Minimum Requirements for the role:

- Winning DNA: Min.18 months in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.

- Over-achievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment

- Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt

- Native German language speakers

Advantageous:

- Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.

- A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don’t rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.

- A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.

- Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity 

We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

title: Staff/Senior Software Engineer - Hydris - Golang (d/f/m)
description:
New Challenge About Us 
Project Q GmbH ("Q") is a Germany-based DefenseTech company with offices in Berlin and Munich. We network market-available sensors, effectors, or situational awareness systems into a tactical IoT backbone that reliably provides armed forces and security agencies with cross-domain information superiority — automated, scalable, and cost-efficient.

Our solutions integrate seamlessly into existing defense and maritime infrastructures, delivering fast data fusion and AI-enhanced analytics for robust situational awareness in dynamic environments. We build platform-agnostic systems that enable real interoperability across domains.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll directly impact the technical direction of our orchestration products – Hydris – the coordination engine for sensors and mission systems, and the interoperability API that underpins it. 

You'll work at the layer where heterogeneous real-world systems like radars, AIS receivers, LoRa mesh radios, satellite feeds, and C2 platforms become a single coherent picture. The problems lie in distributed systems, protocols, and data modeling areas. They play out in environments that are bandwidth-constrained, intermittently connected, and operationally unforgiving. 

The role is deeply hands-on, but it expects you to shape what we build and how we build it, not just deliver what's specified.

What you'll do
Core engine development - Design and build the systems that power Hydris.
- Go is your primary language. You should be comfortable reading Rust and TypeScript across the codebase, even if you're not writing in them day-to-day.
- Own the architecture of a system that must run reliably on edge hardware, in disconnected mesh networks, and at scale — often all of that simultaneously.
Protocol and integration architecture - Evolve the schema that defines how every sensor, asset, and mission system talks to Hydris.
- Make API design decisions that hold up across our client libraries without creating a maintenance burden.
- Continue refining the integration framework that lets Hydris connect to new sensor types, data sources, and command systems.
- Set the patterns for how built-in integrations (ADS-B, AIS, ASTERIX, Meshtastic, SpaceTrack, TAK, federation) are structured, tested, and maintained.
- Make it straightforward for external developers and system vendors to build their own plugins/integrations to Hydris.
Distributed systems - Architect the peer-to-peer mesh and federation layer that keeps Hydris operational in disconnected, denied, intermittent, and limited-bandwidth environments.
- Solve the hard coordination problems: conflict resolution across federated nodes, eventual consistency of entity state, and track correlation across unreliable links.
- Ensure the system degrades gracefully rather than failing completely when connectivity is lost or constrained.
Technical leadership - Set technical standards for the codebase: how we test distributed behavior, how we handle protocol versioning, how we think about backward compatibility in an API-first product.
- Review code with a focus on long-term maintainability and operational correctness, not just feature completion.
- Make build-versus-integrate decisions and help the team clearly understand the trade-offs.

You should apply if you - Have built and shipped distributed systems that run in production, ideally in environments where reliability matters more than convenience.
- Are comfortable working across the stack, from Protobuf schema design and systems-level Go, to the TypeScript that puts a map in front of a user.
- Have well-formed views about API design and protocol evolution, informed by experience maintaining APIs that other people depend on.
- Can operate effectively with a high degree of autonomy but are adept at collaboration with colleagues toward high-quality technical decisions, at scale.
- Are interested in contributing to European military, maritime, and critical infrastructure defence systems.
- Write clearly and communicate architectural decisions in a way that survives beyond the conversation where they were made. 
- Working language is English. German is not required.
You'd be a great fit with - Experience with geospatial systems, sensor fusion, or track management.
- Familiarity with defense or ISR data standards like CoT/TAK, ASTERIX, SAPIENT, MIL-STD-2525.
- Background in networking, mesh architectures, or systems designed for contested or degraded communication environments.
- Experience working on developer-facing open-source infrastructure where adoption depends on the quality of the API and documentation.

We Offer - Remote work anywhere in Germany, or hybrid/on-site in Berlin or Munich if you're already based there and prefer an office.
- High degree of autonomy and ownership, a flat structure, and real input into technical direction.
- Annual €1500 Learning & development budget (available after probation).
- Bike Leasing and Urban Sports Club membership.
- 30 days of paid time off.
Note: We're unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role – candidates must already be eligible to work in Germany.

title: Senior Industrial Designer | Robotics
description:
Your tasks

- Shape the hardware identity: Define how our humanoids look and feel: proportions, surfaces, overall silhouette. You take the design direction we already have and carry it through to physical systems that actually ship.

- Design for passive safety first: Safety sits in the geometry from the first sketch. You work through clearances, pinch points, contact surfaces and fall behavior so the robot is safe around people before software gets involved.

- Integrate complex systems: Package the internals (sensors, cameras, cooling, connectors, cable routing) so the technical parts look intended.

- Physical human machine interaction: Design status signals, touchpoints and small physical cues that tell the people working next to the robot what it is doing and what comes next.

- Build the ecosystem around the robot: Extend the design language to charging docks, transport cases, maintenance gear and packaging.

- From model to CAD: You build physical models fast, see what holds up, and change them until they do. Then you do the surfacing and hand over CAD that engineering can build from directly.

- Materials and processes: Select finishes, review physical samples, and work suppliers on feasibility, cost and lead times. You are willing to try materials that are not standard and to bring in specialized external labs.

Your profile

- Background: A degree in industrial or product design, or an engineering degree where the design side is clearly the stronger half.

- Experience: Around five years or more designing physical products, in house or at a studio. Robotics, medical devices, lab and industrial equipment, mobility, or another field where the hardware has to hold up in front of people.

- Small series: You have worked on products built in the hundreds rather than the millions, and know how much that changes what a shape can be.

- Safety and regulation: You have designed under mechanical safety requirements before, so guarding, clearances and contact safety are familiar territory rather than a new topic.

- Tools: Surface modeling in Rhino, Onshape, SolidWorks or Fusion, plus 3D printing and enough workshop practice to build your own models.

- Working with engineers: You read mechanical drawings, keep up in technical discussions, and can explain why a design decision matters.

- Languages: Fluent English. German is nice to have, not a requirement.

Why us?

- Ownership from day one: The physical design and hardware identity of our humanoids is yours. Short decisions, no approval chains, and you work directly with the founders and lead engineers.

- Everything under one roof: Labs, workshop and test rigs are in the same Kreuzberg building. The engineer you need is a walk away, not a ticket.

- Room to get better: Paid learning time and a personal budget for it, projects where something is allowed to not work the first time, and support for portfolio work and conference talks as the company becomes known.

- Benefits: A benefits package you put together yourself, covering mobility, home setup, health or food. Plus one extra paid day off a year for volunteering or a project you care about.

How to Apply 

Send us your portfolio and a few lines about one product you took from sketch to production : what changed along the way, and why. No cover letter needed. 

Process : Intro call -> Portfolio deep-dive with the founders -> Half-day on-site visit with a small design exercise -> Offer.

We build robots for everyone, so we want a team that reflects that. We hire on what you can do, and we welcome applications from people who are underrepresented in hardware design. If you don't tick every box but think this is your job, apply anyway.

ReciMe ist die am schnellsten wachsende Koch-App der Welt und hilft mehr als 15 Millionen Nutzern dabei, Rezepte von Social Media zu speichern und daraus Essenspläne sowie Einkaufslisten zu erstellen.

Wir sind seit Monaten unter den Top 10 Apps in der Kategorie „Essen & Trinken" im US App Store und expandieren aktuell auch nach Deutschland!

Jetzt suchen wir Content Creator für unser kleines, ambitioniertes Team! Du erstellst wöchtenlich neue Koch- und Rezeptvideos für ReciMe – Skript, Dreh und Schnitt komplett aus einer Hand.

Diese Position ist auf freiberuflicher Basis und perfekt für kleine Creator, die sich ihre Zeit frei einteilen wollen oder nebenberuflich etwas dazu verdienen möchten.

Wichtig: Am Anfang gibt es eine Testproduktion, die wir mit 50€ für ein produziertes Reel vergüten. Dabei wollen wir deine Content Skills testen und sehen wie du die App in Kombination mit dem Kochen präsentierst. 

Danach gibt es dann die Möglichkeit einer längeren Zusammenarbeit auf Stundenbasis und auch Provision basierend auf dem Meta & TikTok Werbebudget.

Je mehr Videos du erstellen kannst und je besser diese skalieren, desto mehr kannst du verdienen!

Aufgaben

- Kochen vor der Kamera – das meiste von dem, was du erstellst, bist du selbst in der Küche, wie du die App tatsächlich nutzt

- Eigene Ansätze und Hooks mitbringen, statt auf ein detailliertes Briefing für jede Anzeige zu warten

- Schnelle Umsetzung – Dreh und Schnitt in derselben Woche

- Die Performance-Daten deiner eigenen Anzeigen nutzen, um diese zu optimieren

- Lernen, was im gesamten Creator-Team funktioniert, und dieses Wissen dementsprechend anwenden

Qualifikation

- Eine Küche, in der du jederzeit drehen kannst

- Du fühlst dich vor der Kamera wohl und kannst authentischen Content erstellen

- Du hast die nötigen Editing Skills um aus deinem Rohmaterial schnell fertige Clips zu schneiden

- Nice to have: Eigene Reichweite im Bereich Food oder Home Cooking

Benefits

- Du kannst dir deine Zeit komplett frei einteilen und remote arbeiten

- Kostenlose ReciMe-Mitgliedschaft für die gesamte Dauer der Zusammenarbeit

title: Chief Technology Officer

High level of personal responsibility, open communication, active involvement in shaping the business, and a motivated, success-oriented team

Flexible Work:

Remote-first with hybrid options, flexible working hours, modern equipment, "workation" opportunities—plus time off on December 24th and 31st

Tech & Innovation:

Modern tech stack and AI-driven culture

Annual bonus, gifts for work anniversaries and milestone birthdays, corporate benefits program, discounted mobile phone plans, company pension contributions exceeding statutory requirements, capital-forming benefits, and automatic salary adjustments at fixed intervals

Commuter pass, bike leasing, and discounted fitness & wellness offers in your city (egym)

- You are fluent in German and English (negotiation level) and—given our ongoing European expansion—ideally possess additional foreign language skills

Benefits

- Key role in positioning the company as a European pioneer of data-driven business models and significantly shaping the tech vision.

- Direct collaboration with the founder and CEO offers great strategic scope and quick decisions.
